strings.(모험가가 레티시아와 함께 광장 북쪽 거리에서 내려와 광장으로 향하는 순: (As the adventurer and Leticia come down from the northern street toward the plaza, a large group of soldiers appears.)
%s, hold on a second. We can't just knock down every soldier...
strings.%s 님, 그런데 오스카 가도로 가는 길 알아여?: %s, do you know the way to Oscar Road?
I know it exists, but I don't know where it is.
What do we do...? First, we need to get out of here...
strings.(일단 건물 뒤에서 몸을 피하고 있던 두 사람 앞에 붉은색 긴 머리 소녀: (While the pair hide behind a building, a girl with long red hair appears before them.)
strings.레티, 그런 거 아니라고 했잖아. 너도 일하다 쉬는 거 좋아하면서 왜 그: Letty, I told you that's not what I'm doing. You like taking breaks from work too, so what's your problem?
strings.그러면 %s 님 잡으려고?: Then are you here to arrest %s?
strings.내가 잡는다고 해도 잡힐 분도 아니고. 그런데 지금 상황 말이야…. 조금: Even if I tried, I doubt I could. But this situation... Doesn't it seem strange?
The soldiers are after %s for plotting to murder Her Majesty... You'd never do that.
strings.그건 맞아. 그런데 왜 실비아는 정상인 거야?: That's true. But why are you normal, Silvia?
strings.난 항상 정상인데…. 레티, 그게 무슨 말이야?: I'm always normal... Letty, what do you mean?
Sorry, Silvia. It's a long story...
We need to get to Oscar Road.
Follow me. I'll explain when we get there.
strings.(다행인지 아닌지 광장에 있던 병사와 기사들이 다른 곳으로 떠나간다.): (Fortunately, or perhaps not, the soldiers and knights in the plaza head elsewhere.)
strings.(상황을 살펴보던 모험가와 레티시아는 실비아를 따라가다 세이렌 석상 근처: (Keeping watch, the adventurer and Leticia follow Silvia and stop before a building near the siren statue.)
strings.(실비아가 뭔가 확인하려는지 건물 뒤쪽으로 돌아간다. 잠시 후, 손을 뻗: (Silvia goes behind the building to check something, then reaches out and beckons them closer.)
There's a path to Oscar Road behind here.
strings.쉿. 조용히 해. 레티: Shh. Keep your voice down, Letty.
strings.가도로 가는 길을 숨겨야만 하는 이유가 있는 건가?: Is there a reason the path has to be hidden?
strings.오스카 가도는 초대 황제 폐하가 아끼던 정원이었다고 해요. 마을 하나 크: They say Oscar Road was a garden treasured by the first emperor. It must have been beautiful for him to turn an area the size of a village into a garden.
strings.신비한 유물 같은 게 잔뜩 있고, 가까운 곳에 아름다운 호수도 있고, 희: I read that it's full of mysterious relics, with a beautiful lake nearby and rare flowers and trees.
strings.14대 이스넬 황제 폐하 시절에 사람들이 그곳에서 마족 때문에 많이 죽어: They say that during the reign of Emperor Isnel XIV, demons killed so many people there that entry was forbidden.
strings.그것 때문인지 아닌지 모르겠지만, 지금은 아는 사람들만 아는 그런 곳이: I don't know if that's why, but now only a few people know about it.
strings.사람들이 하도 찾지 않고, 가는 것조차 꺼려서 이런 건물을 세워 길도 막: People stopped going there and even feared it, so they built this building to block the path.
strings.그 후엔 광장 관리원이 나가서 순찰하고 청소하고 돌아오나 봐. 그거 말고: Since then, the plaza caretaker apparently goes out to patrol and clean it. Apart from that, no one visits the highway...
strings.이걸로 제가 할 일은 끝이에요. 폐하께서 알려주신 게 지금 이렇게 되다니: That's my part done. To think what Her Majesty told me would lead to this...
strings.10년 전…. 카이나 언니, 아니. 폐하께서 즉위하시기 전에 제게 오셔서: Ten years ago... Kaina—no, Her Majesty—came to speak to me before she took the throne.
strings.저는 그냥 아름다운 황녀님을 뵌다고 잔뜩 신나 했었는데, 그 순간이 아직: I was just excited to meet the beautiful princess. But I still remember that moment, so it must have left quite an impression.
She called it her first vision and asked me a favor.
strings.언제가 될지 모르지만, 폐하를 돕는 사람이 글래스턴에서 위험에 빠지는 일: She said she didn't know when, but someone helping her would be in danger in Glaston, and I should show them the way to Oscar Road.
strings.의회의 병사들이 그 사람을 쫓을 것이다, 아르젠트가 시간을 벌어줄 것이다: She also said the Council's soldiers would pursue them, and Argent would buy them time... I never imagined it would be like this.
strings.어쨌든 조심해서 가세요. 저는 오빠가 말한 장소에 가서 숨어있어야 할 거: Anyway, be careful. I think I should hide where my brother told me to.
strings.지금 이 상황이 어떻게 끝날진 모르겠어요. 그래도 다들 아무 일 없었으면: I don't know how this will end. I just hope everyone will be safe.
I'll go, then. Take care, Letty.
Yep, I'll be back. It's my mission, so I'll do it right.
strings.(실비아가 주위에 사람이 없는 걸 확인하고, 서둘러 라슈에트 거리로 뛰어: (After checking that no one is nearby, Silvia hurries toward LaChouette Street.)
Silvia will be fine. The commander is here. Nothing will happen to her.
All right. Let's head to the highway.
strings.(두 사람이 실비아가 알려준 길을 따라 지나가던 중, 커다란 비석들이 언: (Following the path Silvia showed them, the pair see enormous stone monuments embedded in the hillside.)
Is this where Oscar Road starts...? How far do we need to go...?
Let's keep going for now. Look, there's a lake over there.
I didn't know there was a place like this near Glaston.
I've never had a reason to come this way either.
There seems to be a path over there...
strings.(어디까지 가야 할지 몰라 호수를 기점으로 발걸음을 재촉하던 두 사람 앞: (Not knowing how far to go, the pair hurry toward the lake. A thick fog rises before them.)
Ugh, what...? All of a sudden...
strings.(안개는 짙어지다 못해 흩어져 있던 어둠을 몰고 온 것처럼 눈앞에 보이는: (The fog thickens until it fills everything in sight, as though gathering the scattered darkness.)
strings.원래 호수 근처에 물안개가 자주 낀다는 이야기를 들었지만, 이건 너무 하: I've heard mist often forms near lakes, but this is ridiculous.
strings.(일반적인 안개가 아냐. 분명 누군가가 만든 것 같아.): (This isn't ordinary fog. Someone must have made it.)
%s, follow me. This is the way.
Letty? Oh, you found your way through the Magic Administration Building too.
Leave the navigation to me. Oh, %s.
strings.앞에 뭔가 있어여. 동그란 게 둥둥 떠다니는데, 정령왕님은 아닌 거 같고: There's something ahead. Something round is floating there, but I don't think it's the Spirit King.
strings.(모험가가 손을 뻗자, 순간 손이 어딘가로 빨려들어가는 것처럼 쑥 들어간: (The adventurer reaches out, and their hand slips inward as though being sucked into something.)
strings.너, 너 뭐냐? 지금 날 건드린 거냐?: Y-you! What are you? Did you just touch me?
strings.(닫혀있던 유리병이 한 번에 열린 것 마냥 경쾌한 소리와 함께 어딘가에: (With a cheerful pop like an uncorked glass bottle, %s's arm slips free from wherever it had gone.)
strings.(모험가가 정신을 차리지 못하고 있던 그때, 뭔가가 빠른 속도로 날아온다: (While the adventurer is still bewildered, something flies toward them at high speed.)
strings.(뭔가 단단한게 날아올 것 같은 예상과 달리 얼굴로 날아온 건 의외로 부: (Instead of the hard object they expected, a surprisingly soft bundle of cotton hits their face.)
strings.(모험가가 정신을 차리고 얼굴에 달려든 걸 떼고는 빤히 바라본다.): (Recovering, the adventurer pulls the thing off their face and stares at it.)
strings.너는 이거 놓는다. 날 함부로 해선 안된다. 너는 이거 놓는다. 어서!: You let go of this. You mustn't treat me carelessly. You let go. Now!
strings.(잡초 모양 인형이 살아있는 것처럼 버둥댄다.): (A weed-shaped doll struggles as though alive.)
strings.너 뭐야? 키르케가 만든 인형이야?: What are you? A doll Circe made?
strings.(발버둥치던 인형이 잠시 행동을 멈춘다.): (The struggling doll freezes for a moment.)
strings.키르케? 나는 그 나쁜 마녀가 만든 인형 아니야. 아니라고!: Circe? I'm not a doll made by that wicked witch. I'm not!
strings.%s 님, 얘 화났나 봐여. 게다가 마녀도 알고 있어여!: %s, I think it's angry. And it knows a witch!
strings.인형이긴 한데, 약초 정령이야. 착한 마녀가 만든 약초 가방이라고. 그건: I am a doll, but I'm an herb spirit. An herb bag made by a good witch. And stop poking me!
strings.(레티시아가 약초 정령이라고 말하는 인형을 손가락으로 찌르다가 배시시 웃: (Leticia pokes the doll that calls itself an herb spirit, then grins.)
Sorry. It's just so strange. This is only the second time I've seen a spirit like this.
strings.끄응…. 그러니까 약초 정령 너…. 약초 가방에 깃든 정령 같은 거라고: Hmm... So, herb spirit... I can think of you as a spirit living in an herb bag?
That's right, that's right. I'm the spirit Mandarava.
strings.오스카 가도에서 놀고 있었다. 아니, 일하고 있었지. 그러다 너네 두 인: Playing on Oscar Road. No, working. Then I met you two humans.
There you have it, %s. Let's go.
strings.나, 나 이야기 안 끝났어. 안 끝났어!: I-I'm not finished talking. Not finished!
Sorry, Mandarava. We have to go. We don't have time for this...
strings.중요한 이야기라고. 그러니까 두 사람 중요한 이야기 집중해. 집중하라고!: This is important. So you two listen to my important story. Listen!
You won't get there even if you walk all day.
strings.거기라니…. 내가 올 걸 알고 있었어?: There...? You knew I was coming?
strings.나는 네가 그곳으로 갈 수 있는 사람인지 확인했어. 그런 중요한 일 맡은: I checked whether you were someone who could go there. I'm a spirit entrusted with such important work. Ahem.
strings.두 사람 그냥 가면 안개 속에서 계속 같은 곳만 맴돌 거야. 그러니까 너: If you just go, you'll keep circling the same place in the fog. So listen to me.
strings.(레티시아가 그 말과 함께 빠르게 앞으로 달려간다. 잠시 후, 사라졌던: (Leticia runs straight ahead. A little later, she reappears behind the adventurer.)
You were behind me just now, and now you're in front... Hmph.
What suspicious humans. You can get out if you do as I say.
strings.(만다라바가 몸을 탈탈 털자 지퍼가 열리며 그 사이로 작은 꽃 하나가 떨: (Mandarava shakes itself, opening its zipper. A small flower falls out.)
strings.당장 오스카 약초꽃을 잔뜩 가져와. 이렇게 생겼어. 여기서 채집할 수 있: Bring me lots of Oscar Herb Flowers right away. They look like this. You can gather them here.
strings.%s 님, 밑져야 본전인데 해볼까여?: %s, we've got nothing to lose. Shall we try?
strings.만다라바. 그렇게 하면 정말 나갈 수 있는 거지?: Mandarava. If we do that, we really can get out?
strings.정령은 거짓말 안 한다. 속고만 살았어?: Spirits don't lie. Has everyone you've met deceived you?
I've met a lying spirit before. And yes, I was fooled.
Th-that spirit was bad. I'm not bad.
All right. I'll trust you for now.
strings.레티, 내가 앞쪽으로 가서 채집할게요. 레티는 뒤쪽으로 가서 채집해 줘요: Letty, I'll gather them up ahead. Please search behind us.
strings.우와! 우와! 안개 속에서 약초꽃 다 찾았구나. 드디어 나갈 수 있게 됐: Wow! Wow! You found all the herb flowers in the fog. I can finally get out! I can!
strings.드디어 나갈 수 있게 됐다고? 설마 갇힌 거야?: You can finally get out? Were you trapped?
Even monkeys fall from trees sometimes.
strings.약초 정령도 약초 못 찾을 수 있어. 약초를 찾아야 나갈 수 있는 공간이: Even herb spirits can fail to find herbs. This was a space you could only leave after finding the herbs, but suddenly fog appeared and I couldn't see them. I was in trouble.
strings.약초 정령은 그런 거 안 만들어. 만들 줄 모르기도 하고. 하여튼 고맙다: Herb spirits don't make things like that. I don't know how, either. Anyway, thank you. Thank you.
I'll be going now. You should go too.
strings.(만다라바가 그 말만 하고 하늘로 떠오른다. 그러더니 불어오는 여린 바람: (With that, Mandarava floats into the air and drifts away on a gentle breeze like a balloon.)
strings.헤헤, 제가 염력으로 지퍼에다 실을 묶어놓았어여. 느리게 날아가니까 이: Hehe, I used telekinesis to tie a thread to its zipper. It's flying slowly, so we can follow the thread.
Well done, Letty. Let's follow it.
strings.(…여기 좀 이상하네. 어울리지 않는 동물들하고 몬스터가 있는 것 같은데: (...This place is strange. There seem to be animals and monsters that don't belong here...)
strings.(일단 그런 거 생각하지 말고 가보자….): (Let's not worry about that for now...)
I am the perfect herb spirit that no one can stop. But I'm caught on a branch.
strings.(만다라바가 아름답게 빛나는 나무에 걸려 버둥댄다.): (Mandarava struggles, caught in a beautifully glowing tree.)
Who tied this thread to me? Aaagh, if I keep struggling, my fabric will tear. It can't keep tearing...
strings.오스카 가도에 몬스터밖에 없어서 위험하다. 거기 누구 없냐? 누가 좀 살: Oscar Road has nothing but monsters. It's dangerous. Is anyone there? Someone save me! Save this herb spirit!
strings.(만다라바가 앞에 나타난 모험가와 레티시아를 보고 반갑게 손을 흔든다.): (Seeing the adventurer and Leticia, Mandarava waves happily.)
Come here at once. Cut the thread quickly. Do the good deed of helping me.
You really have a way of making people not want to save you.
You talk strangely too. What's with that? What's with that?
strings.(모험가가 손을 뻗어 나무에 걸린 만다라바를 붙잡는 동안, 레티시아가 염: (The adventurer reaches up to hold Mandarava while Leticia cuts the thread with telekinesis.)
The little human's technique is good. Very good.
Thanks for the compliment. You know what? I'm the one who tied this thread.
strings.…이래서 꼬맹이는 싫다……. 마중 나온다는 거 내가 이야기했나?: ...This is why I hate little kids... Did I mention someone was coming to meet you?
strings.(만다라바가 걸려있던 나무들 사이로 기묘한 분위기의 빛이 흘러나온다.): (An eerie light flows between the trees where Mandarava was caught.)
(Through the light, a path leads toward an enormous, ruined-looking castle.)
strings.성이여? 여기 무슨 성이 있다고 그러세여? 황성이 여기서 보이긴 하지만,: A castle? What castle? You can see the imperial palace from here, but it's white.
strings.(모험가가 뭔가에 이끌리듯 발걸음을 옮기려는 순간 누군가의 목소리가 들려: (As the adventurer starts forward, drawn by something, a voice rings out.)
strings.(목소리의 주인이 검집에 손을 올리자 주위에 커다란 섬광이 펼쳐진다.): (The speaker places a hand on her scabbard, and a great flash of light spreads around them.)
(The path to the emerald castle, visible just a moment ago, is gone.)
strings.(흑발의 긴 머리를 찰랑거리며 다가온 여성이 검집에서 손을 뗀다. 그리고: (A woman with long, flowing black hair approaches and takes her hand off her scabbard. She opens a hand fan and fans %s, who is breaking into a cold sweat.)
I cut away the ominous power flowing through the highway. Don't worry.
What do you mean? No, first, who... are you? How do you know me...?
Someone Iris and many others have asked to keep you safe.
strings.(여성이 들고 있던 손부채를 접고는 살짝 미소를 보인다.): (The woman closes her fan and smiles faintly.)
strings.나는 글린다라고 해. 료스알프 출신 엘프면서 귀찮은 운명을 지닌 마녀이기: My name is Glinda. I'm an elf from Ljosalf, and a witch burdened with a troublesome fate.
strings.이리스가 보낸 사람이니 모든 마녀가 [밤]을 쫓는 게 아니란 건 알고 있: If Iris sent you, you know that not every witch pursues [Night], don't you? For now...
This isn't the place to talk. We'll discuss the details in the village.
Wow, wow. I've never met a witch before.
strings.%s, 그대 옆에 있는 이 아이는 누구지? 이리스에게 누가 또 온다는 이: %s, who is this child beside you? Iris didn't mention anyone else coming...
She's a knight who helped me. Circumstances brought us here together.
strings.마녀님과 만난 건 절대로 어디 가서 이야기하지 않을 게여. 한 번 믿어: I promise I'll never tell anyone I met a witch. Please trust me.
Such confidence. Then I will take that as a promise.
strings.만약에 그대의 말을 지키지 않고 함부로 발설한다면 이야기를 들은 사람도: If you break your word and speak carelessly, whoever hears it will be in danger too.
strings.마녀의 저주 같은 건가여?: Is it a witch's curse or something?
%s, this is not your decision. It is hers.
%s, I'm fine. I just have to do as she says.
strings.(글린다가 조용히 고개를 끄덕이고 들고 있던 부채로 레티시아의 어깨를 두: (Glinda nods quietly and taps Leticia's shoulder with her fan.)
Then I grant you entry to the village.
There's no need to worry so much. Just don't cause trouble.
Hehe, nice to meet you, Lady Witch.
Is that how human children talk these days? It grows on you after a while.
Oh, Mandarava. Tell me what happened and why you were late.
strings.글린다, 내 이야기 들어봐. 나 놀고 있던 거 아니다. 약초꽃 채집할 겸: Glinda, listen. I wasn't playing. I went to gather herb flowers and meet these people, but fog suddenly appeared and trapped me.
strings.오스카 가도에 안개가 나타나는 일 없잖아. 없지. 황혼 시절에도 여기 안: Fog never appears on Oscar Road. Never. There wasn't any even during the Twilight... This person gathered the herb flowers, and the fog went away. Phew.
You two, follow me. We shouldn't stay on the highway for long.
strings.(글린다 님, 뭔가 말하려다 만 것 같은데…. 그런데 이거 무슨 소리지?: (It seemed like Lady Glinda stopped herself from saying something... But what's that sound? Is someone playing an instrument...?)
I suddenly heard sad music from somewhere...
strings.무슨 소리? 콜록. 콜록. 기분 탓일 거야. 가자. 안 그러면 놓고 간다: What sound? Cough, cough. You're imagining it. Come on, or I'll leave you behind.
strings.(…잘못들은 건가? 아무 소리도 들려오지 않네….): (...Did I hear it wrong? I can't hear anything now...)
strings.그건 그렇고 먼치킨 수인하고 미믹, 요리 정령은 왜 밖으로 나온 거지?: More importantly, why are the Munchkin beastfolk, mimics, and cooking spirits outside? I'll have to take them back on the way. Cough, cough.
strings.(일행이 글린다의 뒤를 따라 자리를 떠난 후, 나무 사이에서 다시 에메랄: (After the group follows Glinda away, emerald light flows between the trees once more.)
strings.(희미한 안개 속에 빛나는 에메랄드 성 한편에서 한 여성이 그들이 떠난: (From one side of the emerald castle glowing in the faint fog, a woman stares at the place they left.)
You're pretending not to hear the music I play for you...
strings.(글린다를 따라 가도를 걷자 시야에 보이는 풍경들이 순식간에 바뀐다.): (As they follow Glinda along the highway, the scenery changes in an instant.)
strings.(일행이 있었던 곳은 조금 전까지만 해도 호수가 보이던 가도였지만, 지금: (Just moments ago they were on the highway overlooking the lake. Now they stand in a village on an island within it.)
strings.어? 우와아…. 마녀님, 여, 여기 뭔가여?: Huh? Wow... Lady Witch, wh-what is this place?
strings.(동물을 본따 만든 것 같은 귀여운 건물과 아기자기한 분위기가 모험가와: (Cute buildings shaped like animals and the charming atmosphere capture the adventurer's and Leticia's attention.)
strings.마을 이름은 옛날 마족과 맞서 싸운 마녀의 이름을 붙인 거야. 잊지 않으: The village is named after a witch who fought demons long ago. So we would not forget her.
strings.우리를 쫓던 마족을 베면서 발견한 공간이 여기였어. 호수 중심에 있는 이: We discovered this place while cutting down the demons pursuing us. A strange island in the middle of the lake.
strings.우리만 아는, 다른 존재들에게는 들키지 않을 수 있는 장소라면서 도로시가: Dorothy said it could be a place only we knew, hidden from all other beings...
strings.사고로 도로시가 세상을 떠났고, 나는 그런 도로시의 명복을 빌기 위해 여: After Dorothy died in an accident, I settled here to pray for her soul.
strings.어쩌다 보니 불행한 운명을 지닌 자들이 찾아왔는데, 어떤 곳에서도 환영받: Eventually, people burdened with unhappy fates began to arrive. Seeing how unwelcome they were everywhere else, I couldn't turn them away.
That was how the Dorothy Village you see today began.
strings.도로시도 그걸 원했겠지. 불행한 운명을 가진 존재들이 조금이라도 행복하길: Dorothy would have wanted it too. She always wished that those with unhappy fates could find even a little happiness.
As the village's host, let me greet you again. Welcome to Dorothy Village.
It's so pretty, like a village in a fairy tale.
When we looked at the lake from the highway, there wasn't an island...
strings.알고 있겠지만, 다른 대륙에 있는 그 마을과 비슷할 거야. 밖에서는 보이: You probably know a similar village on another continent. Hidden from outside, cut off from the world...
strings.나갈 때는 이 뒤로 쭉 나가면 돼. 호수에 빠질 것 같지만, 아무 생각하: When you leave, go straight back that way. It will look as though you're walking into the lake, but keep going without thinking. You'll find yourself on the highway.
Boss, you're back. Is this the person you mentioned...?
%s, say hello. This is Runo. Runo, this is %s.
strings.(단단한 갑옷을 입은 사슴 수인이 차가운 시선으로 일행을 바라본다.): (A deer beastman in sturdy armor regards the group with a cold gaze.)
strings.루노라고 한다. 도로시 마을의 경비를 맡고 있지. 보스 말로는 당신 혼자: I'm Runo, the village guard. From what the boss said, I thought you were coming alone...
Circumstances left us no choice but to come together.
Runo, I've allowed this child, Letty, to stay in the village.
I'm Leticia. You can call me Letty.
You aren't surprised to see a beastman.
strings.전에 우연한 기회에 수인을 만난 적이 있는데, 그냥 사람이었는데여? 놀랄: I once met a beastperson by chance, and they were just a person. There wasn't a single reason to be surprised.
strings.(레티에게 선입견 같은 게 없다고 해야 하나.): (I suppose Letty doesn't have any prejudices.)
It's that time already. Runo, have a meal and rest for the day.
I was going to patrol the highway... But if you say so, Boss, I'll rest.
I'm afraid you'll go out and play instead of working, like Mandarava.
strings.글린다, 내가 그런 정령이라고 말하는 거야? 아냐. 아냐. 그동안 많이: Glinda, are you saying I'm that kind of spirit? No, no. I've played a lot before, but I was never late. This was the only time.
strings.%s. 만다라바 옆구리에 솜 빠져나온 거 보이지?: %s, see the stuffing coming out of Mandarava's side?
It seems to get grumpy when too much falls out.
Come on, Mandarava. Let's go to Binah. She'll replace it with new stuffing.
strings.오, 새 솜이다. 새 솜. 새 솜을 넣고 뛰어보자. 팔짝, 팔짝. 머리가: Oh, new stuffing. New stuffing! Put in new stuffing and let's jump. Hop, hop. My head will reach the garden.
strings.만다라바하고 대화하는 거 은근히 피곤하단 말이지. 이런 건 역시 비나가: Talking to Mandarava is surprisingly tiring. Binah really is the best person for it.
The house where you'll stay is at the far end. Keep following me.
Then I'll see you later, Boss.
strings.(글린다를 따라 도로시 마을 안으로 들어가는 동안, 레티시아의 입이 계속: (As they follow Glinda into Dorothy Village, Leticia cannot stop exclaiming in amazement.)
Wow. The village is so beautiful I don't know where to look.
Wow! Wooow! The animal-shaped houses are pretty, and even the little chick walking by is pretty.
strings.(레티시아가 가리킨 쪽에 있던 누군가가 귀를 쫑긋거린다. 그러더니 환한: (Someone in the direction Leticia points perks up her ears, then approaches Glinda with a bright smile.)
Mom, I was basking in the sun.
strings.(글린다가 비나라고 부른 고양이 수인을 살며시 안고는 쓰다듬는다.): (Glinda gently embraces and strokes the cat beastgirl she calls Binah.)
You're warm. You must have just woken from a nap here.
Hehe. I did what you told me, Mom.
strings.우와, 마녀님. 이 사람은 누군가여? 너무 예뻐여!: Wow, Lady Witch, who's this? She's so pretty!
%s, this is my adopted daughter, Binah.
strings.냥. 그렇다면 여신님을 위해서 여행 중이라는 그분 맞죠?: Meow. Then you're the one traveling for the goddess, right?
Nice to meet you. I'm Binah.
And this is Leticia, who came with %s.
I'm Leticia. You can call me Letty.
strings.%s하고 레티. 이름 외웠어요. 두 분, 마을에는 언제까지 계세요?: %s and Letty. I've remembered your names. How long will you two be staying?
Meow. Then let's get along while you're here.
Hehe. Cute things are always wonderful.
strings.만다라바에게 새 솜을 채워주렴. 솜이 밖으로 튀어나와서 기분이 안 좋은: Please put fresh stuffing in Mandarava. It's coming out, and I think that's why it's grumpy.
strings.냥. 만다라바. 새 솜 넣은 지 얼마 안 됐잖아. 먼치킨 창고 들어가서: Meow. Mandarava, I only just changed your stuffing. Go into the Munchkin Warehouse and find some new stuffing, and I'll put it in.
Binah is too mean to me. Too mean.
strings.나는 창고 어지러워서 싫은데, 비나는 길 잃고 싶지 않아서 잘 안들어가고: I don't like the warehouse because it's such a mess. You don't go in because you don't want to get lost, and you always send me.
Spirits are good at finding their way.
I like stuffing. I'm going into the warehouse, so stay here and wait. Wait.
strings.(만다라바가 둥실대며 티팟 형태의 건물 앞으로 날아가더니 노크한다. 잠시: (Mandarava floats over to a teapot-shaped building and knocks. Soon, the door opens and a little cat paw pulls it inside.)
Mandarava is fine in every other way, but so stubborn.
It's hard for anyone to truly understand spirits. Even me. Anyway, Binah, is your practice going well?
I've been practicing hard with the baton you made me, Mom.
strings.잘 하고 있구나. 늘 그렇게만 하면 돼. 비나, 나는 이제 두 사람 데리: Well done. Just keep it up. Binah, I'll take these two along now.
strings.냐앙. 저는 만다라바 솜 채워주고, 조금 더 연습할게요. 두 분 이따가: Meow. I'll fill Mandarava with stuffing, then practice a little more. See you two later.
Good luck with your practice, Binah.
Wow, Binah's cute and hardworking. Hehe, see you later.
strings.(갑자기 옷이 당겨지는 느낌을 받은 모험가가 주위를 두리번거린다. 그러다: (Feeling a sudden tug on their clothes, the adventurer looks around and meets the eyes of someone who looks anxious.)
strings.%s, 누구하고 이야기해? 엘리엇?: %s, who are you talking to? Elliot?
strings.(엘리엇이라고 불린 사람이 금방이라도 울것 같은 표정을 짓는다.): (The person called Elliot looks as though he might cry at any moment.)
Glinda... I called you several times...
Sorry. Your voice was so quiet I didn't hear you.
strings.죄송해요……. 이, 이 정도면 될까요?: I'm sorry... I-is this loud enough?
Better than before, but still quiet.
Is it? I'll... try... a little harder.
strings.무슨 일이… 있는 건 아니고요…. 손님이 계셔서 인사를 드리고 싶어서요…: No... nothing's wrong... I saw we had guests and wanted to say hello...
strings.좋아, 그러면 내가 소개해 줄게. 엘리엇, 이쪽은 %s. %s, 여기는: Good. Then I'll introduce you. Elliot, this is %s. %s, this is Elliot. He listens to the villagers' troubles.
strings.엘리엇도 사정이 있어서 우리 마을에 머물고 있어. 벌써 2년 됐지?: Elliot is staying here because of his own circumstances. It's been two years already, hasn't it?
%s...? I feel like I've heard that name somewhere...
A fairly famous person. Ask for details later.
strings.(엘리엇이 시무룩한 표정을 짓다 이내 레티사아로 시선을 옮긴다.): (Elliot looks downcast, then turns to Leticia.)
strings.안녕하세여. 저는 레티시아예여. 레티라고 부르셔도 돼여. 그러면 엘리엇: Hello. I'm Leticia. You can call me Letty. So, big sister Elliot...
Huh? Really? A big brother, then, not a sister.
Elliot, are you all right? You look pale.
I-I'm fine. I'm timid, so... sudden attention makes me a little anxious...
strings.들어가서 좀 쉬어야 하는 거 아닌가요?: Shouldn't you go inside and rest?
strings.신경 써주셔서… 감사해요. 힘내고 있으니까… 괜찮아요. 그러니까 걱정하지: Thank you... for your concern. I'm doing my best... so I'm fine. You don't need to worry...
%s, Lady Witch. I'll take Elliot home.
I-I'm... fine. I still have things to do outside...
strings.(엘리엇이 할 말을 다 끝내지도 못한 채 레티시아에게 붙잡혀 사라진다.): (Before Elliot can finish, Leticia takes him away.)
That child certainly makes the village more interesting.
If he says he's all right, he probably is for now. Though I can't know how he feels inside...
You do it too. Everyone says they're all right in front of others. It's how they keep going.
strings.혹시 글린다 님도 그러신가요?: Do you do that too, Lady Glinda?
Well... I don't particularly feel like answering that right now.
strings.이리스가 그대를 무척 아끼는지 이런 말을 하더군. 혹시 도로시 마을 밖으: Iris must care for you deeply. She said she didn't know whether you'd need to leave Dorothy Village, but if you did, I should help you...
strings.(글린다가 %s의 손에 동그랗고 하얀 물건을 올려놓는다.): (Glinda places a round white object in %s's hand.)
Pretty, isn't it? It's a Moon-Gazing Rabbit Snow Globe I made...
The power within it will keep almost anyone from recognizing you. It should let you travel outside the village.
strings.아는 사람에게 자신을 알아보게 하고 싶다면 이름을 말하면 돼. 그러면 그: If you want someone you know to recognize you, say your name. Then they'll see you properly.
It lasts a few days, so it should be enough while you're staying here.
strings.글래스턴으론 가지 마. 그 마족놈의 힘 때문에 스노우볼이 효과가 없을 수: Don't go to Glaston. That demon's power might stop it from working. I'll give you a few extra, so keep them with you.
Here we are. The building over there is where you and Leticia will stay.
strings.%s, 잘 쉬고 있나보군. 시간 잘 가지?: %s, you seem to be resting well. Time flies, doesn't it?
strings.벌써 온지도 일주일 인가?: Has it already been a week since you arrived?
strings.그러게요, 글린다 님. 시간이 생각보다 빨리 갔어요. 그런데 많이 바쁘셨: It really has, Lady Glinda. Time went faster than I expected. Have you been busy? I feel like I haven't seen you in days...
strings.그대가 신경쓸 일은 아니지만, 일이 좀 많았어. 그건 그렇고, 편하게 지: It's nothing you need to worry about, but I've had a lot to do. Anyway, I prepared two private rooms so you could rest comfortably. How are they?
strings.저 여행을 시작한 후로 이렇게 푹 잔 건 손에 꼽을 정도예요. 신경 써주: I can count on one hand the times I've slept this well since I began my journey. Thanks to your care, I've rested comfortably.
strings.언제 갈진 모르겠지만 그때까지 잘 지내다 가. 그거 말고 그대가 이 마을: I don't know when you'll leave, but enjoy your stay until then. You have nothing else to do in this village.
strings.잘 쉬고 있군. 어?: She's getting a good rest. Hm?
strings.(어디선가 악기 소리가 바람을 타고 %s의 귓가에 맴돈다.): (The sound of an instrument drifts on the wind and lingers in %s's ears.)
strings.(가도에서 들었던 쓸쓸한 멜로디야…. 커다란 현악기 연주가 벌써 며칠째: (It's that lonely melody from the highway... I've heard that large string instrument for days now.)
strings.(잠시 후, 쓸쓸한 멜로디에 이어 시끄러운 관악기 소리가 연달아 마을 가: (Soon, noisy wind instruments join the lonely melody and fill the village.)
The Munchkin tribe is practicing first thing in the morning again.
(Glinda frowns slightly and looks toward the teapot-shaped building.)
strings.그대에게 미리 이야기하는 게 좋겠네. 머무는 동안 엄청나게 시끄러울 거라: I should warn you. It'll be very noisy while you're here.
The Munchkin tribe used to live in a tiny little village in the Creed region.
strings.그런데 마을이 나쁜 마녀의 습격을 받아서 엉망이 됐다면서 여기 오게 됐지: But they came here after a wicked witch attacked and destroyed their village.
strings.크리드면 수인인가요?: If they're from Creed, are they beastfolk?
strings.고양이 수인인데, 비나보다는 많이 작아. 그래도 존재감만큼은 확실한 게: Cat beastfolk, much smaller than Binah. But their presence is unmistakable. They're musically gifted. Watching them play together is astonishing.
Now that you've said that, I'd like to hear them properly someday.
Binah is practicing conducting too, though I don't know when they'll play together.
strings.연주회가 기대되는군요. 아, 해주신다는 이야기를 청해도 될까요?: I'm looking forward to the concert. Oh, may I ask about the explanation you promised?
strings.아, 미안. 마을에 와서 자세한 이야기를 해준다고 했었는데…. 내가 많이: Oh, sorry. I said I'd explain once we reached the village... I'm very late.
strings.3년 전인가, 4년 전인가…. 그대도 알겠지만, 지엔디아 대륙을 가로막고: Three or four years ago... As you know, a huge wall blocking the Jiendia continent disappeared.
I had some idea of what was happening, but I thought it had nothing to do with me...
Then outsiders began finding our village, and their numbers grew. Each time, I erased their memories and sent them back, or cut them down if they seemed dangerous.
strings.마을에 머무는 마녀를 죽이려고 했던 마녀, 마녀 사냥을 목적으로 찾아온: Witches trying to kill the witches here, bounty hunters on witch hunts, and mages who kidnapped beastfolk.
strings.그들의 정체가 뭔지 내겐 중요치 않아. 우리를 위험하게 하면 모두 벨 뿐: Their identities don't matter to me. If they endanger us, I cut them down.
But that alone won't protect the village. So I decided to find another way.
strings.내 지식과 얻은 정보를 조합해 많은 시도를 했지만, 되는 건 하나도 없었: I combined my knowledge with the information I'd gathered and tried many things, but nothing worked. Then I learned one thing...
That gap in time...? Iris calls it the wall. I thought of interfering with it.
strings.걱정 마. 그걸 손댔으면 난 이미 죽었을 거야. 그건 마녀인 나조차 할: Don't worry. If I'd touched it, I'd already be dead. Even a witch like me couldn't do that.
strings.그때 난 마을을 위해 뭐라도 했어야 했어서 눈이 뒤집힌 상태였어. 그래서: At the time, I was desperate to do anything for the village. So I went searching through Seres Temple without a plan.
And I found Iris collapsed nearby.
strings.그래…. 이리스를 보고 그냥 지나치려고도 했지만, 역시 안되겠어서 그대: Yes... I considered passing her by, but I couldn't do it. I carried her back to the village.
strings.지금 생각하면 그건 잘한 선택이었지. 그때 벨로쉬라는 데미갓하고 여러 전: Looking back, it was the right choice. A Demigod named Belosh and several battle priests were at the temple then.
Witches were dying at Belosh's hands simply because the Order had declared them heretics.
Without even checking whether they were guilty, he called it the will of the gods...
strings.(바니타스에서 벨로쉬를 상대했었던 이야기를 짧게 전한다.): (I briefly describe facing Belosh in Vanitas.)
What an interesting way for our connections to intertwine...
strings.어쨌든 이리스를 데려와 깨어나길 기다렸는데, 깨어나진 않았어. 대신 이상: Anyway, I brought Iris here and waited for her to wake, but she didn't. Instead, something strange happened.
strings.더는 우리 마을이 밖에서 보이지 않았어. 내가 원하는 대로…. 내가 한: Our village could no longer be seen from outside. Exactly as I'd wanted... And all I'd done was care for the sleeping Iris...
strings.며칠 뒤 꿈이었지, 아마…. 아름다운 금발 여인이 세레스라고 하면서 나타: A few days later, in a dream, I think... A beautiful blonde woman appeared and said she was Seres.
strings.맞아. 이리스 전의 성계신인 세레스 님. 그분께서 이리스를 신전 앞에 데: Yes. Seres, the God of the Astral Realm before Iris. She said that if I left Iris before the temple, she would soon awaken inside.
strings.마침 데미갓하고 전투 사제들이 다른 곳으로 떠난다는 정보가 돌았지. 그: Just then, I heard the Demigod and battle priests were leaving for somewhere else. I went straight to the temple and left Iris in front of it.
strings.한참 뒤에 어린 사제들이 이리스를 발견하고 놀라 안으로 데려가더라. 신탁: After a while, young priests found Iris and, startled, carried her inside. They said the oracle had been right...
strings.나중에 성계신이 된 이리스가 감사 인사를 보내왔었어. 그때 내가 마을에: Later, after Iris became the God of the Astral Realm, she sent me her thanks. She said she'd seen me bring her to the village in a dream.
strings.그게 계기가 돼서 이리스의 부탁으로 몇 명을 여기서 보호했지. 신의 가호: After that, I protected a few people here at Iris's request. The village was safer under a god's protection, too.
strings.누굴 보호했는지 물어봐도 될까요?: May I ask whom you protected?
strings.힐다와 레피카가 여기 있었어. 힐다는 네가 온다니까 떠났고, 레피카는 힐: Hilda and Lepica stayed here. Hilda left when she heard you were coming. Lepica followed, saying it would be safer together, even though Hilda objected.
strings.자세한 건 모르겠지만, 힐다가 돌아올 일은 없는 것 같군. 맞지?: I don't know the details, but it seems Hilda won't be coming back. Am I right?
strings.(트럼펫 소리가 가득한 연주 소리 사이로 다시 불길한 느낌의 멜로디가 다: (Through the trumpet-filled music, the ominous melody approaches again.)
strings.(가도에서 들었던 그 음악이 계속해서 들려오는데…. 나만 들리는 건가?): (I keep hearing that music from the highway... Am I the only one who hears it?)
strings.시끄럽겠지만, 조금만 참아. 이제 곧 끝나거든. 정 참기 힘들면 숙소 안: It's noisy, but bear with it a little longer. They'll finish soon. If it's too much, go inside your lodging. It should be quiet there.
strings.글린다 님, 괜찮으세요?: Lady Glinda, are you all right?
strings.괜찮아. 그냥 기침이 조금 나오는 것 뿐이야. 그건 그렇고, 그대는 내가: I'm fine. It's just a little cough. Anyway, as I said, I'd like you to rest here without doing anything.
strings.그대, 가만히 못 있는 성격이지?: You're the type who can't sit still, aren't you?
I feel more comfortable doing something.
strings.가만히 있는 걸 추천하지만, 정 그렇다면 마을을 돌아다니면서 할 일을 찾: I recommend resting, but if you insist, look around the village for work. There should be a small task or two.
Just make sure you don't put Dorothy Village in danger.
All right. I have work to do, so I'll take my leave...
strings.(글린다가 대화를 마치고 마을 어딘가로 향한다.): (After the conversation, Glinda heads off into the village.)
strings.힐다와 레피카도 여기 있었다는 걸 보면 확실히 이리스가 도로시 마을하고: If Hilda and Lepica were here too, Iris clearly knows Dorothy Village and Lady Glinda well...
But Lady Glinda seems to be hiding something...
strings.(마을을 돌아다니면서 좀 알아봐야겠다….): (I'll look around the village and see what I can find out...)
strings.(모험가가 쓸쓸한 선율을 애써 무시하며 자리를 떠난다. 그런 모험가의 뒤: (Trying to ignore the lonely melody, the adventurer leaves. Glinda watches them go, then quietly turns her gaze toward the highway.)
strings.(마치 약속이라도 한 것처럼 마을 안에 있던 사람과 정령들이 흩어져 더는: (As though by prior agreement, the people and spirits in the village scatter out of sight.)
strings.(갑자기 조용해졌네…. 일단 좀 쉬면서 생각을 정리해 볼까?): (It's suddenly quiet... Shall I rest a little and sort out my thoughts?)
strings.(%s의 시선이 자연스레 도로시 마을 중앙에 유적처럼 세워진 커다란 비석: (%s's gaze naturally turns toward the enormous stone monument standing like a ruin in the center of Dorothy Village.)
strings.(글린다 님이 숨기는 걸 알아보려고 했을 뿐인데, 왠지 더 복잡해졌네.): (I only wanted to learn what Lady Glinda was hiding, but things have become more complicated.)
strings.(다들 관여하지 말라고만 하는데…, 알게 된 이상 물러날 수도 없을 것: (Everyone tells me not to get involved... But now that I know, I don't think I can back away. Let's put it all together.)
strings.(팁과 티페타라는 용인이 마을에 나타난 것부터….): (Starting with the dragonkin, Tip and Tipeta, appearing in the village...)
strings.(어떻게 찾아서 들어온 거지?): (How did they find their way in?)
strings.(도로시 마을은 글린다 님의 허락이 있어야 들어올 수 있는 마을이야.): (You need Lady Glinda's permission to enter Dorothy Village.)
strings.(허락한 대상이라면 글린다 님이 그런 반응을 보이지 않았을 거야….): (If she'd allowed them in, she wouldn't have reacted like that...)
strings.(예전에 온 것 같지는 않았지. 마을을 살펴보고 있었으니까….): (They didn't seem to have been here before. They were looking around the village...)
strings.(온 적이 있다면 다른 목적으로 먼저 움직였을 거야. 굳이 안 보이게 하: (If they had, they would have acted on their real purpose first. They wouldn't have bothered making themselves invisible.)
strings.(용인 둘이 마을에 들어올 수 있게 누가 도와줬다면 글린다 님처럼 이런: (If someone helped those two dragonkin enter the village, it would have to be someone who can manage a place like this, as Lady Glinda does...)
strings.(그 정도의 능력을 가진 존재라면…, 혹시 마녀? 그러면 글린다 님을 노: (Someone with that much power... A witch, perhaps? Then targeting Lady Glinda would make sense.)
strings.(밤을 쫓지 않는다고 해서 대상이 안 되는 것도 아니니까.): (Not pursuing Night doesn't mean she can't be a target.)
strings.(%s의 시선이 호숫가 바깥쪽 오스카 가도로 향한다.): (%s looks toward Oscar Road beyond the lakeshore.)
strings.(처음 만났던 장소에서 글린다 님은 분명 서두르고 있었어. 뭘 숨기고 싶: (Lady Glinda was clearly in a hurry where we first met. What was she trying to hide...?)
(Just then, the music from before comes from Oscar Road. Shifting key, it grows more passionate and grates on the listener's ears.)
(It sounds like that music is being sent here deliberately. I should investigate. Hm?)
strings.(%s의 시야에 마을 밖으로 나가는 글린다의 뒷모습이 보인다.): (%s sees Glinda heading out of the village.)
Lady Glinda is going outside too... All right, I'll follow her.
strings.(요리조리가 챙겨준 간식이 있으니까 그것 좀 먹자.): (I have the snack the Elusive Boss gave me. I'll eat some of that.)
strings.(오, 색다른 맛이네. 뭐지? 아, 일단 배도 채웠으니 처음부터 제대로: (Oh, what an unusual flavor. What is it? Well, now that I've eaten, let's think this through from the beginning.)
strings.(용인 둘이 마을에 들어올 수 있게 누가 도와줬다면 글린다 님처럼 이런: (If someone helped the two dragonkin enter the village, they must be able to manage this sort of place, like Lady Glinda.)
(Not pursuing Night doesn't mean other witches won't target her.)
strings.만다라바, 혹시 글린다 님 못 봤어?: Mandarava, have you seen Lady Glinda?
strings.글린다? 글린다 못 봤는데? 글린다가 온다는 소리는 못 들었는데?: Glinda? I haven't seen Glinda. I didn't hear she was coming.
strings.글린다 님이 음악 소리를 듣고 밖으로 나왔어. 지금 저 음악이 나하고 글: Lady Glinda heard the music and came outside. Right now, only she and I can hear it...
strings.(만다라바가 둥둥 떠다니다가 %s의 두 손에 붙잡힌다.): (As Mandarava floats around, %s catches it in both hands.)
strings.정령 귀 없어도 잘 들어. 어떤 소리 말하는지 모르겠는데. 새 소리, 바: Spirits hear well even without ears. I don't know which sound you mean. Birds, wind, music? Tell me which.
strings.저 연주 소리 들렸던 거지? 들리는데 그동안 왜 모른 척한 거야?: You heard that music, didn't you? Why have you been pretending not to?
strings.모른 척 한적 없다. 안 물어봐서 대답 안한 것 뿐이야. 글린다가 도로시: I never pretended. You didn't ask, so I didn't answer. Glinda doesn't like talking about Dorothy.
strings.도로시? 사고로 죽었다고 들었어…. 뭐야, 그렇다는 건 이 곡을 연주하는: Dorothy? I heard she died in an accident... Wait, does that mean she's the one playing?
strings.만다라바, 뭔가 알고 있지? 이 음악 소리가 들려오고 나서 마을에 이상한: Mandarava, you know something, don't you? Strange people came to the village after that music started.
They said they were dragonkin, descendants of the Black Dragon.
strings.아, 설마…. 글린다가 싫어해도 어쩔 수 없지. 말해줄게…. 정확하진 않: Oh, it can't be... Glinda may not like it, but I have no choice. I'll tell you... Though I'm not certain.
strings.…도로시가 죽지 않은 건가? 연주만 들으면 글린다를 만나고 싶어 하는 것: ...Did Dorothy not die? From her music, it feels like she wants to see Glinda...
strings.그냥 그렇게 느껴져. 자세한 건 나도 몰라. 그때는 도로시가 사라졌었고,: That's just how it feels. I don't know the details. Dorothy disappeared back then, and everyone thought she was dead...
The music is getting sadder. I think fog is rolling into the highway again.
Oh, was the music causing the fog?
strings.연주가 가도 어디서 들려오는 건지 알 수 있어? 가도를 여러 번 돌아봤지: Can you tell where on the highway the music comes from? I've searched several times, but I can't find the player.
strings.가도 중앙에 굳게 닫힌 문이 있어. 안으로 들어가면 도로시를 볼 수 있을: There's a tightly shut gate in the middle of the highway. If you go inside, you might find Dorothy...
But I don't know whether Glinda is there...
strings.나는 여기서 기다리다가 글린다를 만나게 되면 그곳에 네가 갔다고 이야기할: I'll wait here. If I see Glinda, I'll tell her you've gone there.
%s... Glinda is a little ill. Don't let her stay there too long.
strings.(모험가가 자리를 떠나자 만다라바가 서 있던 위쪽에서 에메랄드빛이 흘러나: (After the adventurer leaves, emerald light spills from above where Mandarava stands.)
I knew the seal had weakened... We can't leave it like this...
strings.(굳게 닫혀 열리지 않을 것 같던 문이 모험가가 손을 대는 순간 살며시: (The gate looks sealed shut, but gently gives way the moment the adventurer touches it.)
strings.(문틈으로 들어간 공간에 있는 건 현재는 사용하지 않는 것 같은 분수대와: (Beyond it are only an apparently unused fountain and a chair. Nothing else is in sight.)
(Yet the lonely music calling to the adventurer continues without pause.)
strings.나는 당신이 누군지 몰라. 하지만, 이렇게 음악을 들려주는 건 할 말이: I don't know who you are. But I think you're playing this music because you have something to say.
strings.이제 모습을 드러내는 건 어때?: Why don't you show yourself now?
strings.(모험가의 말에 쓸쓸하게 흘러가던 연주가 조금씩 느려진다. 그러다 이내: (At the adventurer's words, the lonely music gradually slows. Then the bow slips across the strings, filling the space with a piercing sound.)
strings.(으윽…. 온몸이 마구 찔리는 것 같아….): (Ugh... It feels like I'm being stabbed all over...)
This wasn't meant for you... Go back...
strings.(모험가 외에는 아무도 없던 공간 끝에서 쓸쓸한 어조로 경고하는 한 여성: (A woman's voice gives a lonely warning from the far end of the otherwise empty space.)
I can hear it too. So I need to know.
strings.돌아가…. 돌아가라고…. 나는…, 나는 글린다만 만나면 돼……. 돌아가면: Go back... I said go back... I... I only need to see Glinda... Just go back!!
strings.(목소리의 주인이 신경질을 내는 순간, 다시 활이 미끄러지면서 날카로운: (As the voice grows irritated, the bow slips again and a sharp sound pierces %s.)
I don't want to hurt you... But if you insist on interfering...
strings.(멈췄던 연주가 다시 들려오면서 호숫가 쪽에서 불어오는 바람 때문에 일렁: (The music resumes, and the wind-driven ripples on the lake stop moving.)
(Leaves caught on the pillars and fountain freeze in the breeze. Startled, the adventurer steps back, only to be stopped by an invisible wall.)
strings.(나가지 못하게 결계 같은 걸 만든 거야?): (Did she make a barrier to keep me from leaving?)
strings.(그렇게 주위를 둘러보던 중, 그동안 모습을 보여주지 않던 목소리의 주인: (As the adventurer looks around, the unseen speaker slowly emerges from behind the fountain.)
strings.(금발의 긴 머리에 연녹색 베일을 착용한 엘프 여성이 커다란 현악기를 앞: (An elf woman with long blonde hair and a pale green veil places a large string instrument before her and gazes into the distance.)
strings.(잠깐…. 붕대로 두 눈을 감고 있는데, 어떻게 연주하는 거지?): (Wait... Her eyes are covered with bandages. How can she play?)
strings.당신은 내가 이 상태로 어떻게 연주할지 궁금해하고 있겠지…. 그런 건 상: You're wondering how I can play like this... Don't concern yourself with it.
I won't stop playing until you stop breathing. I already warned you...
strings.(목소리의 주인의 경고와 함께 연주가 좀 더 격정적으로 변하고, 이곳에: (With her warning, the music grows more passionate and tightens around the trapped %s's throat.)
strings.(모험가가 무기를 들어 목소리가 들려오는 곳을 향해 팔을 휘두르지만, 어: (The adventurer raises their weapon and swings toward the voice, but strikes no one.)
strings.(그 순간, %s의 시야에 번쩍하고 커다란 섬광이 들어온다.): (At that moment, a great flash bursts into %s's vision.)
strings.(반짝이는 별이 조각나듯, 떨어지는 빛 사이로 멈춰있던 것들이 서서히 움: (Like a glittering star breaking apart, light falls in fragments, and the frozen things slowly begin to move.)
strings.(다시 호수의 물결이 출렁이고, 작은 나뭇잎이 바람에 흔들리면서 모험가의: (The lake ripples again, leaves stir in the breeze, and the pain constricting the adventurer's throat disappears.)
strings.(그런 %s의 옆으로 붉은 가운을 걸친 누군가가 천천히 지나간다.): (Someone in a red robe slowly walks past %s.)
strings.(금발 엘프 여성이 다시 연주를 이어가려 하지만, 글린다의 입에서 누군가: (The blonde elf tries to resume playing, but hesitates when Glinda speaks a name.)
strings.…그 이름으로 부르지 마! 네 멋대로 그렇게 불러놓고 날 죽였잖아!!: ...Don't call me that! You called me that however you pleased, then killed me!!
Dorothy... You've misunderstood. It's a misunderstanding. Listen to me. Back then...
strings.(자신을 도로테아라고 하던 여성이 다시 연주를 시작하자 주위에 있던 풍경: (As the woman calling herself Dorothea begins playing again, darkness floods the surrounding scenery.)
strings.도로시…. 그만, 여기서 이러지 마. 제발…. 여기는 우리에게 소중한 곳: Dorothy... Stop. Don't do this here. Please... This place is precious to us. Those red shoes I bought you... You're still wearing them...
strings.(글린다가 도로테아를 향해서 손을 뻗는 순간, 갑자기 놀란다.): (Glinda reaches toward Dorothea, then suddenly recoils in surprise.)
strings.이러지 마! 위대한 벽의 틈에서 힘을 끌어오면 안 돼!!: Don't! You mustn't draw power from the gap in the Great Wall!!
strings.(글린다가 검집에 손을 올리는 순간, 주위에 다시 섬광이 일어난다. 그리: (Glinda puts her hand on her scabbard, and another flash erupts. Through the fractured light, a new scene appears.)
(The fountain that was filled with vines and flowers is now flowing with water.)
strings.(도로테아가 분노를 섞어 다시 연주를 이어가려 하지만, 이내 움직임이 멈: (Dorothea tries to resume playing in anger, but her movement suddenly stops.)
strings.이젠 내 활까지 망가뜨려?: Now you've broken my bow too?
Dorothy, listen to me. Back then, you and I...
I don't want to hear your voice anymore... Glinda.
strings.(도로테아가 등을 돌리자, 어디선가 검은 안개가 몰려온다.): (As Dorothea turns away, black fog rushes in.)
strings.글린다, 소용 없어. 이제 네 시간이 얼마 남지 않았다는 걸 알고 있거든: Glinda, it's no use. I know you don't have much time left. I'll return soon and stop what little time remains with my music.
Just as you stopped my life that day. Before the emerald castle...
strings.(아무것도 들리지 않고, 인기척도 느껴지지 않는 시간이 지나자 자연스레: (After a span of silence with no sound or presence, %s's eyes naturally open.)
strings.아무도 없어…. 어디로 간 거지?: No one's here... Where did they go?
(As %s looks around, water overflowing from the fountain pools before them.)
She clearly said it was power drawn from the gap in the Great Wall...
Where did Lady Glinda go? I need to find her...
strings.(만다라바에게 가볼까? 비나 말로는 가도에 있는 모든 걸 다 알고 있다고: (Should I ask Mandarava? Binah said it knows everything on the highway...)
strings.내가 뭐라 했지? 글린다가, 글린다가 아프다고 했잖아. 거기 오래 있지: What did I tell you? Glinda, Glinda is sick! I told you not to let her stay there long. I told you!
strings.도로시를 쫓아 저 안으로 들어가겠다는 걸 붙잡았더니 그 자리에서 쓰러졌어: She said she was going in after Dorothy. When I stopped her, she collapsed right there...
strings.일단 약초의 기운이 좋은 장소에 묻어놓았는데…. 아니, 눕혔는데…. 계속: I buried her somewhere with strong herbal energy... No, laid her down... She kept trying to get up, but I finally convinced her to sleep.
strings.마녀 글린다 고집이 좀 세야지. 이렇게라도 안 하면 에메랄디아에 들어가서: That witch Glinda is so stubborn. If I hadn't, she'd have gone into Emeraldia and died.
strings.만다라바, 이제 이야기해 줘. 글린다 님에게 무슨 일이 있었는지. 너는: Mandarava, tell me now. What happened to Lady Glinda? You know everything.
strings.알고 있다고 해도 당사자가 아닌 내가 말할 순 없어. 없다고. 아, 글린: Even if I know, it's not my story to tell. I can't. Oh, Glinda, why are you getting up? Lie down a little longer.
strings.그럴 순 없어. 쿨럭, 쿨럭. 이대로 있으면 모두가 위험…. 쿨럭, 쿨럭: I can't. Cough, cough. If I stay here, everyone will be in danger... Cough, cough.
strings.글린다! 네가 이러면 모두가 위험할 거란 생각은 안 해봤어? 안 해봤냐고: Glinda! Have you considered that acting like this could put everyone in danger? Have you?
Lady Glinda, stop being stubborn. You need to take care of yourself first.
strings.(글린다가 아무 대답도 하지 못한 채 그대로 나무에 몸을 기대앉는다.): (Unable to answer, Glinda sits back against the tree.)
...Glinda, you really will die if you keep this up.
strings.(글린다를 보고 있던 만다라바가 지퍼를 열고 그 안에서 뭔가를 떨어뜨린다: (Looking at Glinda, Mandarava opens its zipper and drops something out.)
strings.이건 그냥 병이 아니다. 레피카가 필요한 곳이 있다면 쓰라고 준 빈 포션: This isn't just any bottle. It's an empty potion bottle Lepica gave me to use wherever it was needed.
strings.잔말 말고 가서 분수대에 이 병을 던져. 그런 다음에 물이 가득 차면 꺼: Stop talking and throw this bottle into the fountain. Once it's full, take it out and bring it back.
Glinda needs that water. It will help her recover a little.
It has a special power. Once she drinks it, she should be able to tell you something.
strings.혹시 그럴 일은 없겠지만, 레피카의 포션 병을 잃어버렸으면 다시 내게 말: It probably won't happen, but if you lose Lepica's potion bottle, tell me again. I can give you as many as you need.
Oh, that's how it works? All right. I'll be right back.
I'm counting on you, %s. Oh, and don't forget to close the lid.
strings.(만다라바의 설명 그대로 분수대 안으로 레피카의 포션 병을 던진다.): (Following Mandarava's instructions, I throw Lepica's potion bottle into the fountain.)
strings.(잠시 후, 비어있는 포션 병 안으로 물이 채워진다. 이어 모험가가 뚜껑: (Soon, the empty bottle fills with water. When the adventurer closes the lid, the clear water begins to sparkle and glow.)
strings.예쁘다. 뭔가 빛이 가득 담긴 느낌이야…. 아, 이러고 있을 때가 아니지: It's beautiful. It feels like it's filled with light... Oh, this isn't the time for that.
strings.(만다라바가 %s에게 받아 든 포션의 병을 열어 글린다에게 건넨다.): (Mandarava opens the potion bottle received from %s and hands it to Glinda.)
strings.이대로 죽기 싫으면 마셔. 이대로 죽으면 네 능력은 저렇게 변한 도로시가: If you don't want to die like this, drink. If you die now, Dorothy, changed as she is, will take your power. You know that, don't you?
Then the Dorothy Village you want so badly to protect could disappear.
strings.다른 사람들 생각도 좀 해. 어른들이야 그렇다 쳐도 비나는 어떻게 할 건: Think about the others too. Never mind the adults—what about Binah...?
strings.(비나의 이름을 입안에서 되뇌던 글린다가 결심했는지 고개를 끄덕인다.): (Repeating Binah's name under her breath, Glinda seems to reach a decision and nods.)
strings.(글린다가 기침을 참아내며 입에 묻은 피를 힘겹게 닦아낸다.): (Suppressing her cough, Glinda laboriously wipes the blood from her mouth.)
I never wanted to drink this, even at death's door...
strings.(글린다가 눈을 질끈 감고 포션 병에 있던 물을 마신다.): (Glinda squeezes her eyes shut and drinks the water in the potion bottle.)
strings.일단은 괜찮아. 하지만, 다시 음악이 들려온다면 어떻게 될지 모르겠어……: For now. But if the music starts again, I don't know what will happen...
strings.기억의 샘물은 평소엔 그냥 물이지만, 누군가에겐 좋은 약이 된다. 자신을: The Spring Water of Memory is usually just water, but for some, it's good medicine. It's filled with the wish of someone who sacrificed herself and asked to be remembered.
strings.만다라바, 너는 어디까지 알고 있지? 내가 널 만난건 10년밖에 안 된: Mandarava, how much do you know? I only met you ten years ago... That was something Dorothy did long ago...
strings.너무 캐묻지 마. 알잖아. 나 정령인 거!: Don't ask too much. You know I'm a spirit!
strings.글린다 님…. 이야기를 청해도 될까요?: Lady Glinda... May I hear your story?
strings.(글린다가 눈을 감은 채 지난날의 기억을 더듬어간다.): (Glinda closes her eyes and searches through her memories.)
strings.혼돈의 하늘이 끝나고 오랜 시간 동안 대륙은 재건이란 이름으로 꽤 시끄러: For a long time after the Sky of Chaos ended, the continent was bustling with reconstruction.
strings.알프헤임의 료스알프와 도크알프도 당시 대륙 재건에 동참하면서 새로운 미래: The Ljosalf and Dokkalf of Alfheim joined in rebuilding the continent, dreaming of a new future.
strings.그런데, 대륙에 하나둘씩 마녀라는 이름의 존재가 나타나 사람들을 해쳤다는: But reports began to spread of beings called witches appearing across the continent and hurting people.
strings.그 시간을 살고 있던 한 소녀가 있었어. 비나처럼 그냥 꿈 많고 웃음 많: There was a girl living in that era. Like Binah, she was full of dreams and laughter. She believed those stories had nothing to do with her.
strings.그러다 어느 순간 알게 됐어. 본능적으로 남들과는 다른 운명이 됐다는 걸: Then, one day, she knew. Instinctively, she felt her fate had become different from everyone else's.
She'd wanted to live an ordinary life among ordinary elves...
strings.그러던 어느 날, 갑자기 밤이 시작됐고, 원하는 게 있다면 밤을 쫓아가라: One day, Night suddenly began. An unknown witch took the girl's hand, saying that if she wanted something, she should pursue Night.
strings.어딘지 잘 기억나질 않지만, 그곳엔 여러 곳에서 온 여성들이 잔뜩 있었어: I don't remember where it was, but women from all over had gathered there.
strings.그중에서 한 소녀가 눈에 들어왔지. 아름다운 눈동자를 지닌 금발 엘프 소: One girl caught her eye: a blonde elf with beautiful eyes. Saying she'd never met anyone from Ljosalf before, she drew the girl over. That was Dorothy.
strings.도로시와의 대화는 무척 짧았지만, 소녀에겐 너무 좋은 기억이었어. 평범하: Their conversation was brief, but it became a precious memory. Two elf girls who wanted ordinary lives could share their feelings about suddenly becoming witches...
strings.어릴 때 버릇부터 좋아하는 것까지 이야기를 이어가고, 도로시가 들고온 첼: They talked about childhood habits and favorite things. Then, while Dorothy played the cello she'd brought... it happened.
strings.누군가의 목소리가 공간 가득 울려퍼졌어. 귀를 괴롭히는 고통과 함께 목소: Someone's voice rang through the entire space. Along with pain that tormented the ears came the voice's sorrow and rage...
That was part of Walpurgis Night.
strings.그 목소리에 미쳐버린 마녀 하나가 날뛰기 시작했고, 다른 마녀들이 피를: One witch went mad from the voice and began to rampage. Other witches fell to the ground, bleeding...
strings.그때까지 마녀의 운명이 뭔지도 몰랐던 여자아이 둘은 소스라치게 놀라며 도: The two girls, who still didn't understand a witch's fate, could only flee in terror. And, unfortunately, the girl discovered her own power and that of another.
strings.정말이지. 하아…. 다른 마녀들이 쫓아오는 것도 지겨운데, 대륙 곳곳에선: Honestly... Ah... As if being chased by other witches weren't tiresome enough, witch hunts began all over the continent.
strings.마녀도 죽었지만, 아닌 사람도 휘말려서 죽임을 당했었지. 도와주던 사람이: Witches died, but innocent people were caught up and killed too. After watching people who helped us die, we stopped running.
We didn't want to live day after day fated to die at someone else's hands...
strings.그래서 소녀와 도로시는 서로를 지킬 수 있을 정도로 강해지기로 했고, 그: So the girl and Dorothy decided to become strong enough to protect each other. Once they had, they chose a new path.
That is the story of that girl—of Dorothy and me. For now, that is enough.
As for the castle, anything beyond what I experienced myself may not be true.
strings.나무 사이로 보이는 길을 건너면 우리가 알고 있는 에트와르가 아니야. 다: Across the path between those trees is not the Etoile we know. It's another world. Think of somewhere like the Demon Realm.
Emeraldia first appeared in our world during the Twilight.
strings.신이 사라진 세계에 마계를 연결하는 것 같은 길이 생겨서 생명들은 불안에: In a world abandoned by the gods, a path resembling a connection to the Demon Realm appeared, and all living beings trembled in fear.
strings.용기있는 자들이 모여 에메랄디아를 탐험했고, 성의 주인이었던 검은 용 오: Brave souls gathered to explore Emeraldia and met the castle's master, Oz the Black Dragon.
strings.오즈는 항상 에메랄디아와 연결된 세계를 삼켰다면서 이번에도 에트와르가 맛: Oz said he always devoured the worlds connected to Emeraldia. Hoping Etoile would be another delicious meal, he swallowed the heroes.
strings.하지만, 용사들은 오즈의 배를 가르고 밖으로 나왔고, 사악한 용은 뚫린: But the heroes cut open Oz's belly and escaped. Clutching his torn stomach, the wicked dragon vanished with Emeraldia. We thought it would never appear again...
strings.840년쯤이었을까? 그때 한창 나와 도로시는 마녀들과 마녀를 죽이려는 자: Was it around the year 840? Dorothy and I were pursuing our own work while avoiding witches and those who hunted them.
strings.에트와르에 나타나는 마계의 문을 완벽하게 부수고, 부술 수 없는 문들은: We traveled around completely destroying the Demon Realm gates that appeared in Etoile, and sealing those we couldn't destroy as securely as possible.
strings.그러던 중, 수상한 소문을 듣게 됐어. 글래스턴을 비롯한 여러 지역에서: Then we heard a troubling rumor. Children were disappearing in Glaston and other regions.
strings.그때 우리는 에메랄디아를 발견할 수 있었어. 그동안 많은 아이들이 에메랄: That was when we found Emeraldia. Many children had followed the light spilling from it into the castle...
strings.정신을 차리고 들어가려고 하지 않던 아이들은 용인의 손에 붙잡혀 강제로: And those who came to their senses and refused to enter were seized by dragonkin and dragged inside.
strings.그 사이 많은 기사와 병사들이 아이들을 구하러 들어갔지만…. 대부분은 오: Many knights and soldiers went in to rescue them... Most were swallowed by Oz. Even those who returned alive did not return sane...
strings.우리는 서둘러 오스카 가도로 가서 에메랄디아의 입구를 봉인하려고 했는데…: We hurried to Oscar Road to seal Emeraldia's entrance...
strings.해왔던 방법, 가진 힘으로는 도저히 되지 않았어. 전전긍긍하고 있던 내게: But our usual methods and the power we had were nowhere near enough. While I agonized over it, Dorothy seemed to make up her mind...
strings.내 능력을 사용하라고. 그게 말이 돼? 내 능력 '잠식'을 사용해서 도로: She told me to use my power. Can you believe it? To use my power, 'Encroachment,' to speak to her mind and make her a sacrifice for the seal...
strings.그럴 수 없다고 다른 방법을 찾아보자고 했지만, 그 사이에 사람들이 기하: I refused and said we should find another way. But while we hesitated, more and more people were dragged away and killed.
strings.머뭇거리니까 도로시가 더는 안되겠다면서 날 죽이려 했어. 누가 죽던 에메: When I kept hesitating, Dorothy said she couldn't wait any longer and tried to kill me. Whoever died, the other would gain enough power to seal Emeraldia...
strings.도로시를 지켜야 했는데…. 도로시가 내 검을 빼앗아 목에 가져다 대는 순: I was supposed to protect Dorothy... But when she took my sword and held it to her throat, I broke.
At that moment, I felt I had no other choice...
strings.도로시가 가진 마력과 마녀의 능력이 폭발하면서 오즈가 쓰러졌지. 뿔과 머: Dorothy's magic and witch's power exploded, and Oz fell. I cut off his horns and head so he could never rise again. I thought that was the end...
Then Dorothy's mind returned, and I thought I could save her...
At that moment, Oz's soul rose and lunged at me.
strings.그걸 본 도로시가 날 밖으로 밀어냈는데, 갑자기 날카로운 가시덩굴이 도로: Dorothy saw it and pushed me outside. Suddenly, sharp thorny vines wrapped around her face and body, wounding her everywhere. Her eyes were probably injured then...
strings.그렇게 가시덩굴로 가려져 더는 다가갈 수 없을 때, 눈앞에서 선명하던 에: When the thorns covered her so completely that I could no longer approach, Emeraldia vanished before my eyes...
That was the last I saw of Emeraldia and Dorothy...
So you built the village near Oscar Road...
Even though she'd vanished, I believed she wasn't dead. So I kept waiting.
strings.만약 도로시가 죽었다면…. 내가 죽인 거라면 도로시의 능력이 내게 왔을: If Dorothy had died... If I'd killed her, her power would have passed to me.
strings.그게 아니라서 지금까지 기다린 거야. 언젠가 다시 볼 수 있을 거라 생각: Since it hadn't, I waited all this time. I thought I'd see her again someday...
strings.내가 너무 우습지. 또 다시 보게 된다면 에메랄디아가 다시 나타났다는 건: How foolish of me. Seeing her again would mean Emeraldia had returned too.
strings.(긴 이야기를 멈춘 글린다의 표정이 왠지 홀가분해 보인다.): (After finishing her long story, Glinda somehow looks relieved.)
strings.고마워…. 그러면 이야기를 계속할게. 그 후로 난 오랫동안 에메랄디아가: Thank you... Then I'll continue. For a long time afterward, I cut away every ominous presence here to keep Emeraldia from returning...
strings.그래도 도로시가 올 틈만은 만들긴 했지만…, 그게 내 실수였어. 그 사이: But I left an opening through which Dorothy could return... That was my mistake. The dragonkin came through it.
strings.이대로 두면 모두가 위험해져…. 마을을 가리고 있는 결계도 이제 버티진: If this continues, everyone will be in danger... The barrier hiding the village won't hold much longer...
We can do this. We have to protect everyone. I'll help.
I really can't figure you out. You could simply pass by without a word...
Now that I know, I can't just walk away.
Sometimes you seem like Iris, and sometimes you don't... Hehe.
strings.(그런 그때, 한동안 들리지 않았던 연주 소리가 다시 들려오면서 다시 글: (Just then, the music that had been silent for a while begins again, and Glinda writhes in pain.)
Cough, cough. Cough, cough. Dorothy, please... Stop. Please...
strings.글린다 님!! 괜찮아요?!: Lady Glinda!! Are you all right?!
So this is the music you prepared for me, Dorothy...
strings.(글린다가 애써 웃음 짓다 정신을 잃고 그대로 쓰러진다.): (Glinda forces a smile, then loses consciousness and collapses.)
strings.(그 모습을 보고 있던 만다라바가 글린다를 부축해 뒤에 보이는 비석에 기: (Mandarava supports her and props her against the stone monument behind them.)
strings.이야기를 들어보니 지금 도로테아가 잘못 알고 있는 게 많은 것 같다. 그: From what you've said, Dorothea seems to have misunderstood a great deal. Otherwise, she wouldn't play with the intention of killing Glinda...
strings.(가서 도로테아를 만나는 걸로 끝나진 않을 거 같은데…. 마을에서 만났던: (I don't think this will end just by meeting Dorothea... I'll probably face those dragonkin from the village again too...)
strings.아, 잠깐…. 글린다 님이 도로테아에게 위대한 벽의 틈을 사용하면 안된다: Oh, wait... Lady Glinda said Dorothea mustn't use the gap in the Great Wall...
I don't fully understand the situation, but it will affect Iris too...
Mandarava, I'll go into the castle.
I'm sorry this herb spirit can't be more helpful...
strings.아냐. 내가 해야 하는 일일지도 몰라서 가는 거야. 그동안 글린다 님을: It's all right. I'm going because this may be something I have to do. Please look after Lady Glinda while I'm gone.
Understood. Then prepare properly before you go.
strings.(에메랄드빛이 가득한 두 그루 나무 사이의 길을 따라 걸어가자 주위의 풍: (Following the path between two trees filled with emerald light, the adventurer sees the scenery change in an instant.)
strings.(희미하게만 보였던 성의 모습이 드러나면서 조금 전까지 시야에 가득했던: (The castle that was only faintly visible comes into view. The blue lake that filled their sight moments ago is nowhere to be seen.)
strings.(여기가 성곽인 것 같은데 얼마나 긴 거지? 끝이 보이질 않잖아. 게다가: (These seem to be the castle walls. How long are they? I can't see the end. And why are there so many spires...? Ruined buildings float in the sky, like in the Void Sea...)
strings.(주위를 살펴보던 %s의 시선이 멀리 보이는 첨탑 하나에 머문다.): (%s looks around, then fixes their gaze on a distant spire.)
strings.(모험가가 뒤로 물러나 무기를 들어 경계한다. 그러자 첨탑에 기대고 서있: (The adventurer steps back and raises their weapon. Tip, who was leaning against the spire, jumps down in front of them. Tipeta spreads her wings and flies over too.)
strings.어머, 용사님. 내 이름 기억하고 있었구나. 이렇게 다시 만날 줄은 몰랐: Oh, dear hero. You remembered my name. I didn't expect to see you again like this. You came to see me, didn't you? I'm so happy.
strings.용사에게 배가 갈려 죽었으면서 그런 소리가 나와?: How can you say that when a hero cut open your belly and killed you?
Hehe, what does it matter? That was when Oz was alive.
Sigh. My sibling has inherited all of Oz's bad tastes.
Quiet, Tip. You inherited his stupidity.
strings.(이것들 대체 무슨 소릴 하는 거지?): (What on earth are they talking about?)
strings.티페타, 우리 이 정도로 하자. 손님 맞이할 준비는 해야지. 안 그래?: Tipeta, that's enough. We should get ready to welcome our guest, shouldn't we?
Yes, you're right. We have our own work to do.
strings.왜 나를 용사라고 부르는 거야?: Why do you keep calling me a hero?
strings.몰라서 물어? 정의를 실현하기 위해 세계를 구하기 위해 싸우는 게 용사잖: Do you really not know? A hero fights for justice and to save the world. That's what I understand a hero to be. Hehe.
strings.오즈의 배를 가르고 뿔을 뽑으면서 외쳤잖아. 다시 에트와르에 나타난다면: You shouted it while cutting open Oz's belly and pulling out his horns. 'If you appear in Etoile again, we'll do the same thing!' Such threats.
But what now? Just like Oz back then, we've appeared in Etoile again.
strings.(티페타의 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 팁이 검을 들어 %s에게 뛰어든다.): (The moment Tipeta finishes, Tip raises his sword and lunges at %s.)
strings.(모험가가 살짝 놀라지만, 이내 침착하게 팁의 공격을 받아친다. 그리고: (Though briefly startled, the adventurer calmly parries Tip's attack, then dodges Tipeta's mace swinging before their face.)
strings.호오. 그때와 다르게 재미있군. 조금 더 해볼까?: Oho. This is more interesting than before. Shall we keep going?
strings.팁, 우리 여기서 이러지 말자. 굳이 힘 뺄 필요 없어. 이제 곧 도로테: Tip, let's not do this here. There's no need to waste our strength. Dorothea's piece will be finished soon. Let's wait until then.
It was just getting fun... Well, if we must.
strings.팁, 그거 용사님한테 이야기해도 돼? 어차피 죽일 거니까 말해도 상관없잖: Tip, can I tell our hero about that? We're going to kill them anyway, so it doesn't matter.
strings.용사님, 우리는 다시 오즈가 돼서 용사님이 사랑하는 모든 걸 무너뜨릴 거: Dear hero, we'll become Oz again and destroy everything you love. We'll be reborn as the wicked dragon that will devour Etoile.
Dorothea's piece will be complete very soon.
strings.글린다를 고통으로 인도하고, 우리를 다시 오즈로 만들 그런 아름다운 곡이: A beautiful piece that will lead Glinda into torment and turn us back into Oz.
strings.고위 마족의 뿔을 녹여 만든 활로 첼로를 연주한다면 도로테아의 영혼도 좋: When she plays her cello with a bow made from the melted horns of a high-ranking demon, Dorothea's soul will disappear happily too.
strings.그게 좀 미안해. 그동안 엄청나게 괴롭혔거든. 육체가 죽어도 사라지지 않: I do feel a little bad about that. We tormented her so much. We held on to her soul, which wouldn't vanish even after her body died, and made her curse Glinda.
strings.글린다가 도로테아를 죽였다고! 자신의 정의를 위해 널 버렸다고!!: We told her Glinda killed her! That she abandoned her for her own sense of justice!!
strings.그것도 모르고 우리 불쌍한 도로테아의 영혼은 사랑했던 글린다를 죽이기 위: Knowing nothing, poor Dorothea's soul wrote a piece to kill the Glinda she had loved.
strings.우리는 거기에 오즈의 부활을 담을 방법까지 더했고. 아, 이제 곡이 완성: And we added a way to bring Oz back to life. Oh, thinking that it's nearly finished makes my heart race.
How can you say that so casually...?
strings.글래스턴에서 럭스가 네놈을 처리한다더니 그게 잘 안됐나 보군. 우리의 시: Lux said he'd take care of you in Glaston. Apparently that didn't go well. Our moment has come too soon.
strings.(그때, 에메랄디아 어디선가 아름다운 선율이 울려 퍼진다.): (Just then, a beautiful melody echoes from somewhere in Emeraldia.)
Tip, let's go. It won't be long now. There's no need to fight our hero here.
strings.우리가 그토록 기다려온 시간인데, 네놈 요구로 네, 하고 멈출 것 같아?: We've waited so long for this. Do you think we'll just say 'yes' and stop because you ask?
Tipeta, I've changed my mind. That human, before we become Oz...
strings.어차피 죽을 용사니까 그 전에 처리하자고. 여기선 흥이 나질 않으니까 가: Our hero will die anyway, so let's deal with them first. This place doesn't inspire me. Let's wait along the way and finish them there.
Let's cut loose for the first time in ages.
strings.(티페타가 팁의 손목을 붙잡고 힘차게 날갯짓한다. 그러더니 허공에 올라: (Tipeta grabs Tip's wrist and beats her wings. Rising into the air, she sneers at the adventurer.)
strings.용사님. 도로테아의 역작 「몽환의 에메랄디아」가 완성되는 걸 방해하지 마: Dear hero, don't interfere with the completion of Dorothea's masterpiece, 「Dreamlike Emeraldia」. Don't go inserting an intermission wherever you please.
strings.(그 말을 끝으로 티페타가 팁을 붙잡은 채로 슬픈 음악 소리가 들려오는: (With that, Tipeta flies toward the sad music, carrying Tip.)
strings.몽환의 에메랄디아…. 도로테아의 연주에 어울리는 제목이긴 하지만, 이 모: Dreamlike Emeraldia... It suits Dorothea's music, but to think all of this was planned so long ago...
I can't stand by. I have to stop this performance myself.
strings.(아픔과 슬픔, 고통이란 감정이 가득 스며든 선율이 점점 격정적으로 변해: (The melody, steeped in hurt, sorrow, and suffering, grows ever more passionate.)
strings.(에메랄디아에 요동치던 감정을 그대로 받아들인 잔재들이 모험가를 쫓아오지: (Remnants that have absorbed Emeraldia's surging emotions chase the adventurer, but all fall soon afterward.)
strings.하아, 하아…. 뭐가 이렇게 많아. 중간에 팁과 티페타를 상대하는 것도: Hah, hah... Why are there so many? Fighting Tip and Tipeta along the way was hard enough...
strings.(연주 소리가 점점 크게 들리는 걸 보면 다 온 건가?): (The music is getting louder. Am I nearly there?)
strings.(모험가가 앞에 보이는 골목을 돌아선 순간, 멍하니 에메랄디아의 하늘을: (As the adventurer rounds the alley ahead, Dorothea stands there, staring blankly at Emeraldia's sky.)
strings.돌아가줘. 이 음악은 당신을 위한 게 아니야. 이대로 돌아간다면 당신에게: Please go back. This music isn't for you. If you leave now, nothing will happen to you.
A little more playing, and Dreamlike Emeraldia will be complete.
Glinda's death... That's all I need.
strings.글린다 님이 죽으면 당신이 사랑했던 사람들과 장소, 세계가 모두 무너져요: If Lady Glinda dies, the people, places, and world you loved will all fall apart.
My life already fell apart the moment Glinda pointed her sword at me.
strings.글린다는 자신이 살기 위해 날 가시덤불에 밀어넣었어. 그 순간, 난 고통: Glinda pushed me into the thorns to save herself. In that moment, I went blind in agony!!
strings.감히 내 얼굴을 감고 있는 이 붕대를 보고도 그런 말을 할 수 있어?: How dare you say that when you can see these bandages covering my face?
strings.도로테아, 내 이야기 잘 들어요. 그건 거짓된 기억이에요. 팁과 티페타,: Dorothea, listen carefully. Those are false memories. Tip and Tipeta, the two dragonkin, deceived you.
strings.용인들이 오즈를 부활시키기 위해 당신을 이용한 거예요. 당신의 영혼을 붙: The dragonkin used you to resurrect Oz. They held your soul captive and made you hate Glinda.
Dorothea, you have to stop here.
strings.팁? 티페타? 그게 누구야? 이 성의 주인인 오즈 님을 부활시킨다고?: Tip? Tipeta? Who are they? Resurrect Lord Oz, the master of this castle?
strings.오즈 님은, 오즈 님은 죽어가는 날 살려준 사람이야. 그런 오즈 님이 죽: Lord Oz... Lord Oz is the one who saved me when I was dying. It makes no sense to say he died and will be resurrected.
Dorothea, Lady Glinda still misses you.
strings.당신을 잊지 못해서 오스카 가도 근처에서 당신의 이름을 딴 마을을 만들어: She couldn't forget you, so she built a village named after you near Oscar Road and has lived there ever since.
strings.그래도 글린다 님이 당신을 죽였을 거라 생각해요? 당신이 지금 신고 있는: Do you still think she killed you? She's the one who gave you those red shoes you're wearing.
strings.(도로테아가 말을 이어가던 중, 뭔가 이상했는지 두 손으로 머리를 붙잡는: (As Dorothea speaks, something seems wrong. She clutches her head with both hands.)
strings.나는 분명 글린다의 검에…. 아냐, 내가 글린다의 검에 손을 대서…. 화: I was struck by Glinda's sword... No, I touched Glinda's sword... Then she was angry and...
Pushed me into the thorns? Glinda would never do that. Me... me...
strings.오랜 시간 함께 했던 우리는…. 사악한 용 오즈를 쓰러뜨리고 길을 봉인하: We'd been together for so long... We were trying to defeat the wicked dragon Oz and seal the path...
strings.(순간, 도로테아의 몸이 흐릿해졌다 다시 돌아온다.): (For a moment, Dorothea's body blurs, then returns.)
strings.(혼란스러워하던 도로테아가 경직된 자세로 모험가를 응시한다.): (The bewildered Dorothea stiffens and stares at the adventurer.)
strings.(그 순간, 도로테아를 감싸고 있던 에메랄디아의 공기가 변한다.): (At that moment, the air surrounding Dorothea in Emeraldia changes.)
strings.(모험가가 서둘러 도로테아와 간격을 두고 서둘러 무기를 든다.): (The adventurer hurriedly puts distance between them and Dorothea and raises their weapon.)
strings.내 곡의 완성이 머지 않았어. 누구도 내 연주를 막을 수는 없어. 나는…: My piece is nearly complete. No one can stop my performance. I... I am...
strings.(도로테아가 활을 들어 첼로의 현을 켜면서 주위에서 들려오던 소리가 모두: (Dorothea raises her bow and draws it across the cello strings, cutting off every surrounding sound.)
strings.(그리고 글린다를 향한 거짓 감정이 담긴 「몽환의 에메랄디아」만이 울려: (Only 「Dreamlike Emeraldia」 echoes, filled with false feelings toward Glinda.)
...Now just a little, just a little more...
strings.(도로테아가 연주를 방해하는 %s의 공격을 방어하지만, 그 충격으로 활이: (Dorothea blocks %s's attack, but the impact snaps her bow. She tries to keep playing with the broken bow, yet only a harsh roar emerges.)
strings.내가 왜 여기서 이런 연주를 하고 있는 거지? 이런 건 내 음악이 아냐…: Why am I playing this here? This isn't my music... This isn't me...
strings.(도로테아의 눈을 가린 붕대 사이로 눈물이 흘러내린다.): (Tears flow from beneath the bandages covering Dorothea's eyes.)
What have I been doing... all this time...?
strings.(첼로와 함께 주저앉은 도로테아의 머리 위로 조금 전까지도 보이지 않던: (As Dorothea sinks down with her cello, the previously unseen Tipeta and Tip appear above her.)
strings.뭐해? 도로테아!! 연주를 마저 하라고. 연주가 얼마 남지 않았잖아!!: What are you doing, Dorothea?! Finish playing! There's hardly any left!!
strings.우린 널 위해서 특별한 활까지 준비했어. 네 연주로 글린다를 죽이고, 저: We even prepared a special bow for you. Kill Glinda with your music, and kill that human.
Dorothea, we... No, I am Oz. The Oz who has cared for you all this time. Come on, keep playing. Then...
strings.하아, 진짜 답답하네. 그게 뭐 어렵다고. 들고 있는 걸, 줄에 가져다: Argh, this is so frustrating. What's so hard about it? Put that thing you're holding against the strings!!
strings.(보다 못한 팁이 도로테아가 쥐고 있던 활을 빼앗으려고 하는 순간, 움직: (Unable to stand it any longer, Tip tries to snatch Dorothea's bow, then abruptly freezes.)
strings.(팁이 가슴에 꽂힌 활을 부여잡고 고통스럽게 주저앉는다.): (Tip clutches the bow embedded in his chest and collapses in agony.)
strings.도로테아? 정신이 들어요?: Dorothea? Have you come to your senses?
strings.미안해. 내가 당신과 글린다를 오해했어…. 잘못됐다는 걸 너무 늦게 알아: I'm sorry. I misunderstood you and Glinda... I realized far too late that something was wrong...
strings.그것도 모르고 저 용인들에게 속아 오랜 시간을 에메랄디아와 에트와르를 연: Without knowing, I let those dragonkin deceive me and spent so long trying to connect Emeraldia to Etoile...
strings.(티페타의 품 안에서 정신을 잃었던 팁이 천천히 먼지가 되어 사라진다.): (Unconscious in Tipeta's arms, Tip slowly crumbles into dust and disappears.)
strings.티페타, 당신…. 고위 마족의 뿔 두개로 활을 만들면 연주가 완성되는 줄: Tipeta... You thought a bow made from two high-ranking demon horns would complete the performance... But one of those horns was purified by a Demigod.
strings.오래 전 용사가 약점이라고는 전혀 보이지 않던 사악한 용을 어떻게 상대했: You didn't even know how the heroes of old fought a wicked dragon that seemed to have no weakness.
In Freios, purified demon horns have long been used to hunt wicked dragons and dragonkin. Oz, who came from another world, wouldn't have known.
strings.오즈, 나 이제 제대로 당신을 기억해 냈어. 글린다가 목을 베고 뿔까지: Oz, now I remember you properly. Glinda cut off your head and tore out your horns, but your soul still clung to me and refused to let go...
strings.그래서 네 영혼을 오랫동안 이곳에 머물게 해줬잖아!!: And thanks to that, your soul was able to stay here all this time!!
strings.티페타, 이제 그만 해. 당신도 이젠 오래 버티지 못할 거야. 다시 부활: Tipeta, stop now. You won't last much longer either. It will take centuries for you to revive again...
strings.(도로테아의 말에 분노한 티페타가 소리를 지르자 에메랄디아에 몰려있던 불: (Enraged by Dorothea's words, Tipeta screams, and the ominous power gathered in Emeraldia rushes around her.)
strings.(에메랄디아의 빛이 어둠에 삼켜지면서 잔해만 남아있던 성곽 주변이 세차게: (Darkness swallows Emeraldia's light, and the ruined castle walls shake violently.)
Dorothea, we have to get out.
(The adventurer reaches out to take Dorothea's hand, but cannot grasp it.)
strings.난 이미 죽은 몸. 영혼만 오즈에 의해 이곳에 묶여 있어. 에메랄디아의: My body is already dead. Oz has bound only my soul here. Unless you're a remnant of Emeraldia, you cannot touch me.
strings.%s, 서둘러. 당신이 에메랄디아를 나갈 수 있는 순간은 지금뿐이야. 저: %s, hurry. This is your only chance to leave Emeraldia. Go that way.
If you get outside, I'll send a little luck your way.
All right. I'll trust you and leave.
strings.(도로테아가 티페타의 분노 어린 공격을 피해서 밖으로 나가는 %s의 발걸: (Dorothea listens to %s's footsteps retreating outside, avoiding Tipeta's furious attacks.)
strings.(그리고 젖어있던 눈가를 매만지며 허공을 응시한다.): (Then she touches her tear-stained eyes and gazes into empty space.)
strings.내 기억을 일깨워준 게 마녀라니…. 역시 당신, 내 '희생'의 능력이 필: To think a witch restored my memories... You need my power of 'Sacrifice,' don't you?
strings.알았어. 그러면 하나만 약속해. 그래, 고마워. 나도 당신의 마음이 느껴: All right. Then promise me one thing. Yes, thank you. I can feel your heart too. Your feelings for someone precious—that alone is enough.
strings.(그런 도로테아의 앞으로 누군가가 선물하는 것 같은 새로운 활이 나타난다: (A new bow appears before Dorothea, as though someone has given it to her.)
strings.(도로테아가 다시 자세를 잡고 연주를 시작한다. 슬픔과 아픔, 고통까지도: (Dorothea settles into position and begins playing again. The lonely melody that once held sorrow, hurt, and pain changes into joy, happiness, and warmth.)
strings.(모험가를 쫓던 티페타가 서둘러 도로테아에게 달려오던 순간, 에메랄디아에: (Tipeta, who had been pursuing the adventurer, rushes toward Dorothea. At that moment, Emeraldia's green light turns to shadow and covers everything.)
strings.오즈, 난 이제 꿈속에서 깨어나 사라질게. 이제 「몽환의 에메랄디아」는: Oz, I'll awaken from the dream and vanish now. 「Dreamlike Emeraldia」 is for you now, not Glinda.
strings.%s, 빨리 붙잡아라!! 아무 말 말고 붙잡으라고!!: %s, grab on! Hurry!! Don't say anything, just grab on!!
(Mandarava suddenly appears before %s, who is running toward Oscar Road.)
strings.시간이 없어!! 에메랄디아가 사, 사라져가고 있다고!! 이대로 있다간 이: There's no time!! Emeraldia is d-disappearing!! If we stay here, everyone in this domain will vanish!!
strings.(만다라바가 서둘러 옆구리에서 실을 뽑아 모험가를 둘둘 감는다.): (Mandarava hurriedly pulls thread from its side and wraps it around the adventurer.)
strings.바람의 정령들아. 불어, 더 세게 불어!! 후우우우, 하고 불어!: Spirits of the wind, blow! Blow harder!! Blow with a whooooosh!
strings.(그러자 어디선가 강한 바람이 불어와 만다라바와 모험가를 순식간에 날려버: (A powerful gust blows in from somewhere and sends Mandarava and the adventurer flying in an instant.)
strings.우와아아아아! 날아간다아아! 아니, 떨어진다아아아아!: Waaaaah! I'm flyiiiing! No, I'm falliiiing!
strings.(정신을 차려 앞을 보니 모험가가 만다라바를 깔고 엎어져 있다.): (Coming to their senses, the adventurer finds themself lying on top of Mandarava.)
strings.(나무 사이에 있던 에메랄디아로 가는 길이 흐릿해져간다. 멀리서 이곳을: (The path to Emeraldia between the trees fades. The emerald castle in the distance crumbles and grows faint as well.)
strings.(그리고 모험가를 쫓아오던 마수들마저 움직임을 멈추며 점점 흐릿해져 사라: (Even the beasts pursuing the adventurer stop moving, fade, and disappear.)
strings.(길이었던 곳에 자란 나무만이 남아 불어오는 바람에 흔들릴 뿐, 에메랄디: (Only the trees where the path once stood remain, swaying in the wind. No trace of Emeraldia is left.)
strings.(만다라바에게 에메랄디아에서 일어난 일들을 전한다.): (I tell Mandarava what happened in Emeraldia.)
It's good that Dorothea came to her senses, but...
strings.지금 보기엔 괜찮지만, 오랫동안 에메랄디아를 막기 위해 많은 힘을 사용해: She looks all right now, but she's used so much power to hold back Emeraldia for so long that she could die at any moment...
If we leave her like this, Glinda will surely...
strings.(만다라바의 놀란 표정에 모험가가 뒤를 돌아본다. 언제 나타났는지 쓰러진: (At Mandarava's startled expression, the adventurer turns around. Dorothea has appeared, searching for the fallen Glinda.)
strings.정령님…, 오랜만이야. 그런데, 글린다는 어디에 있어………?: Spirit... It's been a long time. But where is Glinda...?
strings.시간이 없어…. 에메랄디아에 있던 것이 조금 밖에 남아있지 않아서 글린다: There's no time... So little of Emeraldia remains that I can't sense Glinda...
strings.(모험가가 도로테아에게 손을 뻗지만, 손은 그대로 지나쳐간다.): (The adventurer reaches toward Dorothea, but their hand passes straight through her.)
I can help. Dorothea, over here. Glinda is sleeping for a little while.
strings.(몸이 흐릿해졋다가 원래대로 돌아오던 도로테아가 손을 뻗어 만다라바를 붙: (Her body flickering in and out, Dorothea reaches out and takes Mandarava's hand. Then she finds Glinda beside it.)
strings.(만다라바가 글린다를 일으켜 세워 근처 바위에 기대게 한다. 그러자 도로: (Mandarava raises Glinda and props her against a nearby rock. Dorothea reaches out to embrace her gently.)
strings.(그러나 영혼 상태의 도로테아의 손길이 닿진 않는다.): (But Dorothea's spectral hands cannot touch her.)
Glinda, I wanted to see your face... I wanted to feel your warmth...
strings.그때 내가 스스로 정했던 결정이었어. 순간적으로 겁을 먹었나 봐. 두려웠: Back then, it was my own decision. I must have lost my nerve for a moment. I was afraid. Terrified... But I knew it had to be done...
strings.순간, 오즈가 내 영혼에 갈라진 틈을 발견해서 날 에메랄디아로 이끈 거야: In that moment, Oz found a crack in my soul and drew me into Emeraldia. Without realizing part of my soul had been devoured, I...
I misunderstood you for so long, believing that false dream was the truth...
strings.미안해…. 널 오랫동안 괴롭게 했어…. 하지만, 이제 괜찮을 거야. 글린: I'm sorry... I made you suffer for so long... But you'll be all right now. Glinda. I...
(At that moment, Glinda opens her eyes and reaches for Dorothea's face. Her hand passes through the faint figure.)
I meant to leave before you woke...
Leave...? We've only just met again. Where are you going? Dorothy... I'm right here.
strings.그럴 수 없어…. 오즈가 날 붙잡은 순간부터 내 영혼은 악몽과 같은 곳에: I can't stay... Ever since Oz captured me, my soul has been bound to that nightmare.
I'll... I'll find some way to put your soul somewhere else...
strings.그러지 마, 글린다. 네가 자꾸 그러면 내가 오즈를 상대한 보람이 없잖아: Don't, Glinda. If you keep doing that, everything I did to face Oz will be for nothing.
strings.(도로테아가 살며시 미소를 보이자 점점 색이 바라듯 조금씩 흐려진다.): (Dorothea smiles softly and gradually fades, as though her colors are washing away.)
strings.에메랄디아의 남은 빛이 조금 있으면 전부 사라져. 이걸로 에트와르도 어느: The last of Emeraldia's light will soon disappear. Etoile will be a little safer now.
Glinda, now you have to be all right. That's my wish.
strings.그때 내 손을 붙잡고 밤에서 벗어나게 해준 것처럼, 언젠가 다시 내가 네: Just as you took my hand and led me out of Night, someday I'll take your hand again. Here...
strings.(그 말을 끝으로 도로테아의 모습이 사라져 더는 보이지 않는다.): (With those final words, Dorothea disappears from sight.)
strings.(글린다가 손을 뻗어 남겨진 빛을 품에 안으려 하지만, 빛은 잡히지 않는: (Glinda reaches out to gather the remaining light in her arms, but cannot hold it. Only Dorothea's red shoes remain.)
strings.(그 모습을 뒤에서 지켜보고 있던 %s의 앞으로 만다라바가 다가온다.): (Mandarava approaches %s, who has been watching from behind.)
strings.이제 글린다는 아프지 않을 거야. 도로시의 능력이 글린다의 삶을 지속하게: Glinda won't be ill anymore. Dorothy's power let her life continue. And that power seems to have passed to another witch.
Let's go now. We need to tell Runo, who's waiting for Glinda...
strings.(마을에 들어오자마자 루노가 달려와 만다라바를 붙잡는다.): (As soon as they enter the village, Runo runs over and grabs Mandarava.)
Glinda isn't ill anymore. She's all right now.
I need to see her right away...
strings.기다려, 루노. 글린다에겐 시간이 필요해. 글린다가 네게 시간을 준 것처: Wait, Runo. Glinda needs time. Just as she gave you time...
strings.(루노가 경계를 풀면서 빨간색이었던 눈동자가 다시 원래대로 돌아간다.): (As Runo relaxes his guard, his red eyes return to their original color.)
%s... I'm sorry. The boss ordered me not to follow.
strings.괜찮아요. 마을은 별일 없었죠?: It's all right. Nothing happened in the village?
Nothing. I prepared thoroughly in case those dragonkin returned.
strings.다행히 마을 사람들도 눈치 차리지 못한 것 같고. 아, 엘리엇이 알고 있: Fortunately, the villagers don't seem to have noticed. Oh, Elliot knew...
Elliot is good at keeping people's troubles confidential, so that's fine.
He cries a lot, but he's stronger and more admirable than anyone.
strings.둘이 창고 탐험하겠다고 들어갔다. 벌써 몇 시간 째지? 요리조리가 괜찮다: They went into the warehouse to explore. How many hours has it been now? The Elusive Boss says they're fine, so I'm keeping watch.
I'm fine... Just a little worn out.
strings.피곤해 보인다. %s. 쉬는 게 좋겠어. 에메랄디아는 엄연히 다른 세계라: You look tired, %s. You should rest. Emeraldia is another world, after all. Visiting alone would be exhausting, and you pushed yourself even further...
strings.(만다라바가 지퍼를 열어 안에서 약초를 하나 꺼낸다. 웃는 모습으로 버둥: (Mandarava opens its zipper and takes out an herb. Smiling and wriggling, it seems to be a kind of happy mandrake.)
Wait while I knock it unconscious. Swallowing this has an incredible restorative effect.
It's all right. I'll pass. A little sleep should do...
All right. Go and rest. Leave the rest to us.
You're part of Dorothy Village too.
Talking to you only tires my mouth. Fine. You go rest too, Mandarava.
strings.고맙다, 루노. 나는 지붕에서 일광욕하면서 글린다가 오나 지켜볼게. %: Thank you, Runo. I'll sunbathe on the roof and watch for Glinda. %s, go inside and rest.
All right, Mandarava. See you later too, Runo.
strings.(모험가가 숙소로 향하자 마자 만다라바 또한 고양이 모양 집 지붕으로 떠: (As soon as the adventurer heads toward the lodging, Mandarava floats up to the roof of a cat-shaped house.)
strings.(하지만, 얼마 지나지 않아 다시 루노가 있는 곳으로 내려온다.): (But before long, it comes back down to Runo.)
Glinda is coming with a guest. They're coming together.
A guest? The boss didn't mention one...
strings.(비나가 기지개를 켜며 숙소에서 나오는 %s의 모습에 놀란다.): (Binah is startled to see %s emerge from the lodging, stretching.)
strings.지금 며칠 만에 일어나신 줄 아세여? 아니. 아세요? 냥? 고양이 수인보: Do you know how many days you've been asleep? I mean, do you? Meow? You slept longer than a cat beastperson!
What? I thought it was only a few hours...
strings.벌써, 벌써!! 냥. 일주일이나 주무셨다고요! 제가 아무리 자고 싶어도: It's been, it's been!! Meow. You've slept for a whole week! I couldn't sleep that long no matter how much I wanted to.
strings.일주일이나 자다니…. 그런데 아무도 안깨운 거예요?: A whole week...? And no one woke me?
strings.안 그래도 레티 언니가 죽은 거 아닌가 하고 하루에 두 번씩 쿡쿡 찔렀는: Letty wondered if you'd died and poked you twice a day, but you just snored and never woke up, so she gave up.
