Mom said to leave you alone, too.
strings.친구 만나러 갔다 오신거 말씀하시는 거죠? 정말 오랜만에 친구 만나서: You mean from seeing her friend? She said it was wonderful to see her after so long.
Meow-ha. I love seeing Mom smile so happily.
strings.%s 님, 저 레티 언니랑 또 창고 탐험하려는데, 같이 가실래요? 엘리엇: %s, Letty and I are exploring the warehouse again. Want to come? Elliot says he'll go next time. He needs to prepare himself.
strings.글린다 님을 뵈러 가야 해서 나중에 같이 가요. 어, 그러고 보니 어떻게: I need to see Lady Glinda, so let's go another time. Oh, how did you get out, anyway?
Bunny Bunny said we were noisy and took us outside. Oh, Bunny Bunny is the one from that ghost story we talked about.
strings.헤헤, 맞아요. 저는 무서워서 덜덜 떨고 있는데, 레티 언니가 먼저 가서: Hehe, yes. I was trembling in fear, but Letty went right up and kept talking.
strings.저도 용기 내서 엄마 이야기를 하니까 흥미롭게 듣더라고요. 저 괴롭히면: I worked up the courage to talk about Mom, and she seemed interested. When I said I'd tell Mom if she bullied me, she recoiled. It was so cute. Meow.
Ah ha ha. She must really like Glinda...
It's that time already. Meow-yaaawn. I'm a little sleepy, but I'm fine. See you later, %s. Hehe.
strings.(비나가 %s에게 인사를 하고 빠른 걸음으로 먼치킨 창고쪽을 향해 달려간: (Binah says goodbye to %s and hurries toward the Munchkin Warehouse.)
strings.비나! 창고 탐험한다고 늦게 오지 말고. 일찍 나와! 알았지? 약속대로: Binah! Don't stay late exploring the warehouse. Come out early! Understood? And as we agreed, Elliot goes another time!
strings.하아. 잔소리를 하고 싶지 않지만, 루세리아하고 같이 놀고 있어서 말이야: Sigh. I don't want to nag, but she's playing with Luceria...
Did you sleep well? You showed no sign of waking for a week. I thought you'd died.
strings.그래? 몸은 괜찮아? 에메랄디아를 다녀왔으니 바로 쓰러져도 이상하지 않았: Did she? Are you feeling all right? After visiting Emeraldia, it wouldn't have been surprising if you'd collapsed immediately.
strings.괜찮다면 다행이야…. 아, 잠깐 이야기할 게 있는데 이쪽으로 오겠어?: I'm glad... Oh, there's something I'd like to discuss. Would you come this way?
strings.(글린다가 %s 앞에 좋은 약초로 우렸다는 차를 만들어 내민다.): (Glinda brews tea from fine herbs and sets it before %s.)
strings.그대 덕분에 그동안 어리석었던 내 과오를 깨달았어. 마을을 지킨다는 명목: Thanks to you, I realized how foolish I'd been. I'd bound myself in the name of protecting the village...
No. You're a benefactor to me and our entire village.
At first, I thought you were simply a human blessed by Iris. I was wrong. You're far more than that...
strings.난 괜찮아. 괜찮지 않아도 괜찮게 만들 거야. 그렇지 않으면 도로시가 실: I am. And even if I'm not, I'll make sure I will be. Otherwise Dorothy would be disappointed, wouldn't she? My life continues because of her.
%s, I won't live only in hiding anymore.
strings.다른 마녀들은 잘 모르겠지만, 나는 이제 조금은 밖으로 나가야겠어. 이대: I don't know about the other witches, but I need to go outside a little. Nothing will change if I stay as I am.
strings.이왕 이렇게 된 거 검은 달의 여신이 내린 운명에 맞서보려고…. 그것도: Since things have come to this, I'll try defying the fate the Goddess of the Black Moon gave me... That wouldn't be so bad.
strings.그리고 아무 조건 없이 그대를 돕겠어. 그대가 내게 보여준 신의를 생각한: And I will help you without conditions. After the trust you've shown me, it's only right to repay you.
Lady Glinda, just hearing that is enough to...
strings.어둠으로 뒤덮인 슬픈 꿈에서 깨어날 수 있게 해줬잖아. 내가 이렇게 말하: You helped me awaken from a sorrowful dream covered in darkness. I mean what I say, so accept it.
I'll rest in the village and look into Lady Pandora's whereabouts.
strings.다프네가 함께 있다면 쉽지 않을 거야. 다프네는 사고 자체가 일반 사람과: If Daphne is with her, it won't be easy. Daphne's very way of thinking differs from ordinary people's.
strings.지금 다프네 곁에 있는 마녀는 둘. 키르케와 판도라. 다프네가 이 둘을: Two witches are beside Daphne now: Circe and Pandora. I don't know how she intends to use them...
strings.그댈 위해 내가 계속 알아봐 주겠어. 시간이 좀 걸릴 것 같은데, 그 사: I'll keep looking into it for you. It may take some time. Meanwhile, why not spend it with someone you know?
strings.(그 말과 함께 누군가가 %s의 어깨를 지팡이 같은 것으로 두드린다.): (At those words, someone taps %s's shoulder with something like a staff.)
(The adventurer turns to see a familiar woman smiling as she lowers her staff.)
How did you get here? And those clothes...
strings.다른 대륙에서 할 일이 생겼다는 걸 샤이닉이 듣고는 이오 님과 합세해서: Shynic heard I had business on another continent, so she joined forces with Lady Io and commissioned an outfit from someone named Crisien. Sigh... I had little choice...
strings.그래서 지금부터 말씀드리려고 해요. 다프네가 남긴 '어떤 것'에 대해서…: That's what I'd like to tell you about now. About 'something' Daphne left behind...
